title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join us? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements. Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months. Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team. Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements. For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans. Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines. Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams. What is expected of you Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment. A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from. The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them. Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software. Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning. We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English. Additional experience we value: Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis). Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM). Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer). A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Tracking Specialist Intern
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: The Data & Measurement team makes sure every interaction on our website and apps is measured accurately, reliably and in a privacy-compliant way. We own the tracking architecture (Google Tag Manager web and server-side, GA4, advertising platform tags) across 17 markets. The data we collect powers marketing performance, product analytics and business decisions across the company. Be a part of the movement. Join the circular revolution. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Implement and maintain tags, triggers and variables in our Google Tag Manager containers (web and server-side), for analytics and advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta. Specify and QA dataLayer events with our developers, and make sure new features ship with the right tracking. Run tracking audits and QA across markets: detect broken or missing events, investigate data discrepancies, and follow fixes through to production. Contribute to tracking monitoring by building checks and alerts on data quality in BigQuery. Make sure tracking respects user consent choices and privacy regulations, working with our consent management platform and legal teams. Keep our tracking plan and documentation up to date, so every team knows what is collected and why. Answer tracking questions from Marketing, Product and Data teams, and help them trust the numbers. YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ You are in the final year of a Master's degree in engineering, business, data or digital marketing (or equivalent), looking for a 6-month internship. You have a first experience or a strong interest in web analytics and tag management (GTM, GA4 or similar). You understand JavaScript and can read, debug and write simple scripts, and you are comfortable with HTML and browser developer tools. You know some SQL, or want to get hands-on with BigQuery. You care about data quality and details, and enjoy investigating why a number looks wrong. You have an interest in privacy and consent topics (GDPR, cookies, CMPs). You communicate clearly and are comfortable working with developers, marketers and analysts. You are fluent in French and English (both are mandatory). BONUS POINT : Knowledge of server-side tagging, experience with an advertising platform (Google Ads, Meta), or a personal project involving tracking or data. ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: Start date: January 2027 Duration : 6 months Full-time internship (35h/week) Location : Paris (France) RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅 Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min) Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min) Cultural fit interview with the manager (30min) WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training. At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values. We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications. If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team. title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. Menlo Security's Talent Acquisition team builds great experiences for candidates and hiring teams alike. As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll be the trusted talent partner for department leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design, finding and closing the right people while protecting Menlo's distinctive, inclusive culture. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders as a subject matter expert on technical hiring, and you'll be part of a collaborative team that values ownership and high-quality work. The team uses AI-assisted sourcing and screening tools to move faster and reach a wider, more diverse pool of candidates, so you can spend more time on the parts of recruiting that need human judgment: relationship-building, negotiation, and candidate advocacy. manager satisfaction score Offer-acceptance rate Candidate experience score What You'll Do Own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles, primarily Engineering, Product, and Design, flexing to other teams as business needs shift Build an ongoing pipeline of skilled, diverse talent by combining market knowledge, business priorities, and external hiring trends Partner with senior leaders and hiring managers as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on technical hiring Use AI-assisted sourcing and resume-screening tools to widen and speed up pipeline generation, then apply judgment on fit AI-assisted sourcing, screening, and interview-summary tools as part of daily recruiting work Experience building or scaling talent communities for critical or hard-to-fill skill areas MSGL-I4 Follow description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight. This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you. Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does. Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test. Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover. Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers. Who We're Looking For A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out. Your Background 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers. Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar. Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills. Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted. Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it. Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware. Nice to Have ROS 2. Hardware-in-the-loop rigs and bench automation. Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Functional safety or comparable standards work. On-prem, air-gapped or defence deployment experience. Having been on call for hardware in the field. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Dabei verbindest du dein Immobilien- und Verhandlungsgeschick mit einem konkreten Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Mobilität. Deine Arbeit hat sichtbare Ergebnisse: Aus deinen Analysen, Gesprächen und Verhandlungen entstehen neue Schnellladestationen, die täglich von Menschen in ganz Deutschland und Europa genutzt werden. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit unseren Teams aus Architektur, Legal, Construction und Operations zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Lösungen, teilt Wissen und bringt neue Ideen in die Umsetzung. Ausserdem wollen wir in deiner Region ein kleines Team aufbauen, womit sich dir die Chance bietet Verantwortung für juniorigere Teammitglieder zu übernehmen. Bei Fastned hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, welches nicht auf etablierte Standards wartet, sondern diese aktiv gestaltet. Elektromobilität und Schnellladeinfrastruktur sind für dich noch neu? Kein Problem. Wir unterstützen dich mit einem umfassenden Onboarding und relevanten Workshops. Das bringst du mit Du hast mindestens 6 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der gewerblichen Immobilienwirtschaft, Standortakquise, Projektentwicklung. Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Akquise von Standorten oder Immobilien und im Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen, Unternehmen oder Kommunen. Du bist erfahren in der Vorbereitung und Führung von Verhandlungen, idealerweise im Zusammenhang mit Pacht-, Miet- oder Kaufverträgen. Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis dafür, wie Immobilien und Standorte bewertet werden. Dazu gehören beispielsweise Lage, Sichtbarkeit, Erreichbarkeit, Verkehrsanbindung, wirtschaftliche Attraktivität und grundsätzliche Machbarkeit. Du kannst relevante Informationen strukturiert analysieren und daraus eine fundierte Einschätzung oder Empfehlung ableiten. Erfahrung mit Karten-, CRM- oder Analysetools ist von Vorteil. Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, kommunizierst sicher und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Partner:innen zusammen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und bringst deine Projekte aktiv voran. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Du bist bereit das Deutsche Team einmal im Monat in Köln zu besuchen, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen und freust dich auch auf gelegentliche Besuche in unserem Headquarter in Amsterdam Du musst kein:e Expert:in für Elektromobilität oder technische Immobilienbewertung sein. title: Agentic Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world's leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you're hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. The Impact You Will Have: As an Agentic Software Engineer on the Platform Architecture squad, you will build the multi-agent systems that autonomously refactor and modernize Sonar's own codebase — starting with one of our biggest technical bets: unifying SonarQube Cloud (SQC) and SonarQube Server (SQS) onto a single, portable architecture ("build once, deploy twice"). You will: Design and build agentic refactoring pipelines that can safely extract a domain's logic from our existing SQS/SQC codebases and re-platform it onto our Unified Core (a hexagonal "capability-core + adapters" architecture), with minimal human oversight. Define the guardrails that make autonomous refactoring safe at scale — verification gates, automated test generation, static analysis, and rollback strategies that let agents move fast without breaking production code relied on by 7M+ developers. Prove the approach on real migrations — Micronaut-to-Spring conversions, Lambda-to-container consolidations, API convergence (consolidating overlapping API surfaces onto shared contracts), and strangler-fig domain extractions — before scaling it into a repeatable, multi-agent "coding squad" capable of tackling many domains in parallel. Stay hands-on in the Java/Spring codebase often enough to critically review what the agents produce, recognize when a refactor is architecturally wrong, and correct the agentic loop that generated it — not just the output. What You Will Do Spend the majority of your time (roughly 70%) designing, building, and iterating on agentic tooling: orchestration, tool-use, context management, and evaluation harnesses for autonomous code-modification agents. Build and refine the verification layer that gates what agents are allowed to ship — automated test generation, regression detection, static analysis (using our own SonarQube), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where warranted. Spend the remainder of your time (roughly 30%) hands-on in our Java/Spring codebase: reviewing agent-generated pull requests, fixing what they get wrong, and feeding those lessons back into the tooling. Partner closely with the Server, Cloud Platform, and value-stream squads whose domains you're migrating — earning their trust and buy-in matters as much as the code itself. Contribute to the Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and standards that govern how our platform evolves. Track and evaluate emerging agent frameworks and techniques, bringing back what's genuinely useful — as distinct from what's just hype — for accelerating engineering across Sonar. Experience and qualifications Hands-on experience building or operating multi-agent or LLM-agent systems in a real production setting — not just prompting a coding assistant, but designing the orchestration, tool-use, and guardrails around autonomous agents. Experience building evaluation or verification systems for AI-generated changes: automated testing, static analysis, regression detection, or comparable safety nets for code you didn't personally write. Strong software engineering fundamentals in Java and Spring (or a comparable JVM/enterprise stack) — enough to read a large, mature codebase critically and tell good architecture from bad. A track record of owning complex, ambiguous technical problems independently and driving them to resolution — this is an R&D-flavored role inside a production platform team, and you'll be shaping the playbook, not following one. Experience influencing engineers and squads you don't manage — the migrations you'll enable depend on their trust as much as on your code. Additional comments This role is based in Bochum, Germany . We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum , but we are willing to relocate the right candidate. Benefits Pension Scheme: 1st Pillar (Unterstützungskasse): Automatic, financed by Sonar, 3% of gross salary, an additional benefit in addition to your salary. Pension Scheme:2nd Pillar (bAV): Voluntary, 15% contribution by Sonar from social security savings. We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 28 PTO days plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances. Sonar recognizes holidays on working calendar days. If the holiday date occurs on a Saturday, we will recognize the day on the preceding Friday. If the holiday date occurs on a Sunday, we will recognize the day on the following Monday. Public transport reimbursement of 60% for annual subscription. Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually. Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities. We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company. Salary range: We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at . QM & Sustainability : Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis für Qualitätsmanagement und Nachhaltigkeit. Verhandlungsstärke : Du verhandelst souverän und selbstbewusst, auch dann, wenn es ungemütlich wird. title: Head of Supply Chain (f/m/d) - Berlin
description: About us At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road. From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show. Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities. Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead! Your Mission As Head of Supply Chain , you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will: Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil. Warum wir? Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht. Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat. Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig. title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Ab sofort Das erwartet dich Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management. Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert. Das erwartet dich Plattform entwickeln und gestalten Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle) Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt Automatisieren und standardisieren GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance Das bringst du mit Must-have Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform) Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten Nice-to-have Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana) Persönlich Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern Was wir dir bieten Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen. Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt. title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness. Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern : Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Was du mitbringen solltest 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung. Sichere Praxis in TypeScript oder JavaScript, idealerweise mit React oder Next.js. Ein aktuelles Projekt, das du zeigen kannst: Produktionscode, Side Project oder Open Source. Du arbeitest gern quer über den ganzen Stack und magst Frontend und Backend ähnlich gern. Du verantwortest Features end-to-end und kannst bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer ein gutes Interface gestalten. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":145,"335559740":264}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body" data-ccp-parastyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"baa2b379-a6d3-56f4-af2b-6a08de9434e5|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[469777841,"Aeonik",469777842,"Aeonik",469777843,"Aeonik",469777844,"Aeonik",469769226,"Aeonik",201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",201341986,"1",268442635,"20",335551500,"197122",335559740,"264",201341983,"0",335559738,"145",469775450,"FIR Body",201340122,"2",134234082,"true",134233614,"true",469778129,"FIRBody",335572020,"1",469778324,"Body Text"]}">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">to deliver energy-efficient AI </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">compute</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body"> at scale to customers.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":145,"335559740":264}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">proprietary, and built to scale.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":145,"335559740":264}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p class="FIRBody">We are seeking a versatile<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM)<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, large-scale technical programs at Firmus. Depending on the assignment, you may be externally facing – managing delivery with our key customers, including major hyper-scalers and frontier model builders – or internally facing, driving the strategic infrastructure and platform programs that power Firmus AI Cloud. In both cases, you will act as the bridge between engineering, operations, and business teams to ensure initiatives land with minimal disruption and maximum value.</p> <p class="FIRBody">As the owner of program delivery, you will translate ambiguity into structured, phased plans, manage complex technical dependencies across stakeholders, and keep everyone aligned from working teams through to executive leadership. You will drive implementation, ensure milestones and adoption targets are met, establish feedback loops, and make the technical trade-off decisions that balance delivery velocity with customer and business impact—whether the “customer” sits outside the company or within it.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Key Responsibilities</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p class="FIRBodyList">You’ll own the delivery of your programs end to end – turning ambiguous goals into structured, phased plans with clear scope, timelines, and milestones, and running the operating rhythm of daily or weekly syncs, executive status meetings, and stakeholder communications that keep everyone aligned on readiness, roadmaps, and impact. Throughout, you’ll make the technical trade-off decisions that balance internal velocity against customer and business impact.</p> <p class="FIRBodyList">Depending on the assignment, that delivery is either externally facing—acting as the trusted point of contact for major hyper-scalers and frontier model builders, owning customer communications and advisories, and driving adoption milestones and feedback loops—or internally facing, leading the cross-team platform and infrastructure programs that power Firmus AI Cloud and aligning internal sponsors and engineering leaders on roadmaps and delivery. Either way, you’ll apply the same rigour and stakeholder discipline.</p> <p class="FIRBodyList">Across both, you’ll bring enough command of our systems—AI Factory architecture, GPU performance and benchmarking, and infrastructure constraints—to answer questions directly and validate impact assessments rather than just relaying between teams. You’ll orchestrate delivery across engineering, operations, and customer-facing functions, and run a regular leadership cadence to manage escalations and hold communication timelines.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559685":720,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Skills & Experience</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p class="FIRBody">You’ll bring at least 10 years in Technical Program or Project Management, including 4+ years leading large-scale transformation programs, whether that’s with direct external customer exposure or delivering internal enterprise programs. Just as important is technical fluency across the AI/ML stack: a robust understanding of AI hardware, large-scale networks, and cloud architectures, grounded in practical experience building, scaling, and operating high-density infrastructure and systems.</p> <p class="FIRBody">Communication is central to this role. You can draft a customer-facing advisory that is clear, empathetic, and technically accurate – not a cut-and-paste from an LLM – and you use a range of tools (like Jira) day to day to build the artifacts and plans that organize, communicate, and drive customer and program success. You pair this with strong stakeholder management across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and internal engineering leaders, and you’re comfortable in high-ambiguity environments where program structures often need to be created rather than simply followed.</p> <p class="FIRBody">Ideally, you bring a proven track record delivering programs such as enterprise feature rollouts with title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Optimove, we believe people are capable of more than a single job description. You’re not hired just to fill a position- you’re empowered to shape it, grow it, and make it your own.<br>We call this being Positionless.<br>And Positionless isn’t just our culture. It’s our product.<br>Optimove is the creator of Positionless Marketing, an AI-powered platform that gives every marketer the power to analyze, create, launch, and optimize independently. The result is faster execution, deeper personalization, and 88% greater campaign efficiency.<br>Recognized as a Visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant, we partner with leading brands like Sephora, Staples, and Entain. Today, more than 500 Optimovers across NYC, London, Tel Aviv, Scotland, Brazil, Estonia, and beyond are building the future of marketing together, in an environment that actively encourages ownership and growth, with two out of every three managers promoted from within.<br>If you’re looking for a place where you can do more, be more, come grow with us.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll join our Personalize team, helping shape and build the products that let our customers personalise messages across every digital touchpoint. You'll work with text data and with cutting-edge technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs), bringing Accessible Intelligence to our customers across both Personalize and Optimove's overall platforms.</p> <p>This is a role for an engineer who's ready to own meaningful, medium-sized pieces of our personalisation roadmap end-to-end - from problem framing through to deployment and monitoring - and trusted to do so with minimal oversight. It's not solo delivery: you'll be working closely with a dynamic team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, and should be happy to contribute at every level, from early-stage research through to production support.</p> <p><strong>Role & Core Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the delivery of medium-sized ML features end-to-end within Personalize - problem framing, data preparation, model build/train, evaluation, deployment and monitoring - to predictable timelines.</li> <li>Develop predictive ML models for classification, ranking and personalisation, working with our text data.</li> <li>Leverage LLMs and other state-of-the-art techniques to enhance product capabilities.</li> <li>Operationalise models as APIs across real-time and batch environments.</li> <li>Monitor production models in your own scope, treating data quality issues and model degradation as a priority.</li> <li>Research new ML applications and improve pre-existing models, sharing findings with the wider ML, MLOps and engineering team.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product, MLOps and engineering teams to define and prepare new ML applications, contributing meaningfully to planning and grooming.</li> <li>Proactively surface and resolve technical and data challenges before they affect delivery, model quality or customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Best Bits of the Job</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to a wide range of ML domains, including large-scale search, ranking, Natural Language Processing, hybridisation, classification and text data processing.</li> <li>Working with modern ML technologies, including LLMs, to enhance our products.</li> <li>Fully real-time architecture for data processing, model development and deployment.</li> <li>Deploying and enhancing ML frameworks, optimising for inference and training/retraining cycles.</li> <li>Online testing of models with live data, using our proprietary A/B/N testing technology to see quickly what performs well.</li> <li>A supportive, collaborative team spanning ML, MLOps and software engineering, where rapid experimentation is the norm.</li> <li>Dedicated time to research new methods, build proofs-of-concept, and ship to production quickly when they work.</li> <li>Everyday use of modern AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude) to speed up experimentation and review.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related field, <strong>OR</strong> 1–4 years' professional experience building and deploying ML models.</li> <li>Strong understanding of core ML concepts - supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering - and broad familiarity with common algorithms and architectures.</li> <li>Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, etc.) and SQL skills</li> <li>Comfortable with the standard ML toolkit: Git, Docker, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and ML pipelines.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with text data and relevant Natural Language Processing techniques.</li> <li>Solid experience with cloud technologies and data storage solutions, including Snowflake.</li> <li>Everyday use of AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude), and a basic understanding of responsible AI practices - data privacy, bias/fairness and explainability.</li> <li>Must be eligible to work in the UK – we are unable to provide sponsorship at this time</li> <li>This is a Hybrid role, and you will be required in our Dundee office two days per week. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of personalisation across domains such as sports betting and gaming, and what best practice looks like there.</li> <li>Full understanding of recommendation algorithms and their applications.</li> <li>Professional experience in personalisation and/or predictive CRM, and micro-segmentation.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Bicep, etc.).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth & Progression</strong></p> <p>This role sits on the in-role path towards Senior Machine Learning Engineer. As you grow, you'll deepen your expertise in our core ML stack, take on end-to-end ownership of larger features, represent the team in cross-functional planning with MLOps and software engineering.</p> <p><strong>Working at Optimove</strong></p> <p>Optimove offers a vibrant, people‑first culture where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning shape everything we do. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><p>Ogilvy Health DACH ist eine grenzenlos agierende Kreativagentur, die durch nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und Märkte hinweg Projekte realisiert – von lokalen Initiativen bis hin zu globalen Kampagnen. Unser Team arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von <strong>Healthcare, Social Media, Strategie, Experience und Influence</strong>.</p> <p>Von Zürich aus betreuen wir das Healthcare-Portfolio von Ogilvy für die DACH-Region sowie ausgewählte internationale Kund:innen aus den Bereichen Pharma, Biotech und Medizintechnik. Unser interdisziplinäres Health-Team vereint Account Management, Medical Writing, PR, Digital, Strategie und Kreation.</p> <p>Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine:n<strong> Designer/ Art Director Health (m/w/d) </strong>in Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt/ Main, Düsseldorf oder Zürich. </p> <p> Das bieten wir:</p> <ul> <li>Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Mobile Office (bis zu 100%) </li> <li>Nutzung unseres WPP Weiterbildungsnetzwerkes, inkl. LinkedIn Learning </li> <li>Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge und die Gewährung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen </li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen </li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes </li> <li>Erweiterte Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zusätzlichen Budget von bis zu 300€ im Jahr </li> <li>Zugriff auf unser Employee Assistance Programm TELUS Health </li> <li>Kostenlose Nutzung der Headspace-App </li> <li>Subventionierte Gympass-Mitgliedschaft </li> </ul> <p>Deine Aufgaben: </p> <p>Als Art Director Health entwickelst und gestaltest du Kommunikationslösungen für renommierte Kund:innen aus dem Healthcare- und Pharmabereich. Dein Aufgabenspektrum reicht – je nach Projekt – von konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln wie Flyern, Broschüren, Präsentationen und Sales-Materialien bis hin zu visuellen Identitäten, digitalen Inhalten und integrierten Kampagnen.<br>Du entwickelst starke visuelle Konzepte, übersetzt medizinische und wissenschaftliche Inhalte in klare, relevante Kommunikation und begleitest Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Medical Writing, Client Services, Strategie, Creative Direction, Digital, PR, Production und externen Partner:innen zusammen.<br>Die Rolle erfordert kreative Exzellenz und ein gutes Verständnis für die besonderen Anforderungen der Healthcare-Kommunikation – insbesondere für Rx-Produkte, regulatorische Vorgaben und Review-Prozesse.</p> <ul> <li>Konzeption und Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln für Print, Digital, Social Media und Bewegtbild – von Flyern, Broschüren und Präsentationen bis zu digitalen Assets und Kampagnenformaten</li> <li>Entwicklung visueller Identitäten, Corporate Designs, Branding-Lösungen, Kampagnenwelten und visueller Narrative für Pharma-, Biotech- und Medtech-Kund:innen</li> <li>Übersetzung medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Inhalte in klare, zielgruppengerechte und visuell überzeugende Lösungen, insbesondere für Rx-, Disease-Awareness- und Patient-Engagement-Projekte</li> <li>Präsentation und überzeugende Vermittlung von Ideen gegenüber Kund:innen sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung und Sicherstellung der gestalterischen Qualität über alle Kanäle und Formate hinweg</li> <li>Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partner:innen wie Fotograf:innen, Filmproduktionen, Freelancer:innen und Partneragenturen sowie Unterstützung bei Pitches, Neugeschäftsprojekten und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kund:innenbeziehungen</li> </ul> <p>Was du mitbringst: </p> <ul> <li>Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Grafiker:in EFZ, Studium in Visueller Kommunikation, Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Art Director in einer Healthcare-, Pharma- oder Kommunikationsagentur</li> <li>Fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen aus Pharma, Biotech und/oder Medtech sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Kommunikationsmassnahmen für Rx-Produkte</li> <li>Gutes Verständnis für medizinische Inhalte, regulatorische Anforderungen und Review-Prozesse in der Healthcare-Kommunikation</li> <li>Ausgeprägte konzeptionelle und gestalterische Fähigkeiten, ein überzeugendes Portfolio sowie sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud und gängigen Design- und Präsentationstools</li> <li>Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Patient Engagement, PR- und Awareness-Kampagnen sowie Kenntnisse in Motion Design und Social/Digital Content Creation sind ein Plus.</li> <li>Du verbindest kreative Exzellenz mit strategischem Denken und kannst komplexe Inhalte schnell erfassen und in relevante visuelle Ideen übersetzen.</li> <li>Du arbeitest proaktiv, selbständig, lösungsorientiert und zuverlässig – sowohl an grösseren Projekten als auch an konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln im Tagesgeschäft.</li> <li>Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst sicher und kannst Kund:innen für deine Ideen begeistern. Die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams macht dir Freude.</li> <li>Du bringst Resilienz und Flexibilität für einen dynamischen und phasenweise intensiven Agenturalltag mit. Nicht alles ist planbar, Prioritäten und Timings können sich kurzfristig ändern.</li> <li>Auch bei hohem Tempo und mehreren parallelen Projekten bewahrst du den Überblick, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und übernimmst Verantwortung. In intensiven Phasen bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit dem Team die Extrameile zu gehen.</li> </ul> <p>Wir glauben an die Kraft von Diversität und Kollaboration. Den Herausforderungen der heutigen Welt können wir nur gemeinsam begegnen. Wir verpflichten uns daher, für den Job in Frage kommende Bewerber:innen ausschließlich nach ihren Fähigkeiten und grundsätzlich unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Religion zu beurteilen.</p> <p>Das klingt nach einer spannenden Herausforderung? Sehr gut, dein Ansprechpartner Kai Schlüter freut sich über deine Bewerbung!<br>Aus Gründen der Nachhaltigkeit und des Datenschutzes bitten wir darum, Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich über unsere Bewerber:innenplattform Greenhouse an uns zu senden. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auf das Mitsenden eines Fotos verzichtet würde.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du unsere Kunden bei anspruchsvollen Transformationsprojekten entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette moderner Payment-Lösungen – von der Business Analyse und Fachkonzeption über Testing bis hin zur Implementierungsbegleitung.</p> <p>Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie und erhältst Einblicke in moderne Payment-Architekturen, regulatorische Anforderungen und innovative Zahlungsverkehrslösungen innerhalb eines dynamischen und internationalen Umfelds. Dabei nutzt Du geeignete, freigegebene AI-Tools und AI-gestützte Workflows, um Analysen, Qualität und Produktivität zu unterstützen – stets mit menschlicher Beurteilung und unter Berücksichtigung geltender Responsible-AI-Leitplanken.</p> <p><strong>Deine Aufgaben</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du begleitest anspruchsvolle Beratungsprojekte im Zahlungsverkehr – von der Business Analyse und Fachkonzeption bis hin zu Testing und Implementierungsbegleitung.</li> <li>Du arbeitest an Transformationsprojekten rund um moderne Zahlungsverkehrsarchitekturen, regulatorische Anforderungen und innovative Payment-Lösungen.</li> <li>Du arbeitest mit Kunden und Projektteams sowohl in klassischen Wasserfallprojekten als auch in agilen Delivery-Umfeldern zusammen und setzt freigegebene AI-Tools, Automatisierung und AI-gestützte Workflows dort ein, wo sie Geschwindigkeit, Qualität oder Erkenntnisgewinn verbessern können.</li> <li>Du übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Themenbereiche bis hin zur Steuerung von Teilprojekten und kleineren Projektteams und stellst beim Einsatz von AI durch Review, menschliche Beurteilung und definierte Eskalationswege eine verantwortungsvolle Nutzung sicher.</li> <li>Du gestaltest interne Themen aktiv mit und unterstützt die fachliche, methodische und persönliche Weiterentwicklung innerhalb von Capco.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Dein Profil</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium sowie relevante praktische Erfahrung in Beratungsprojekten im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld.</li> <li>Du hast großes Interesse an Payments sowie Kenntnisse relevanter Themen und Prozesse wie PSD3/PSR, SEPA Classic, Instant Payments, TARGET2, TIPS, Clearing & Settlement, Cash Management oder Correspondent Banking.</li> <li>Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und arbeitest teamorientiert sowie kundenfokussiert.</li> <li>Du verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und bist bereit, abhängig vom Projekteinsatz im nationalen und internationalen Umfeld zu reisen.</li> <li>Du bist neugierig auf neue AI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen und bereit, freigegebene AI- und Automatisierungstools verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen, Ergebnisse kritisch zu prüfen und geltende Leitplanken, Review- und Eskalationsprozesse einzuhalten.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Von Vorteil</strong></p> <ul> <li>Erfahrung mit komplexen Payments-Transformationsprogrammen oder der Weiterentwicklung von Zahlungsverkehrsarchitekturen.</li> <li>Vertiefte Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren Bereichen wie Instant Payments, Clearing & Settlement, Cash Management oder Correspondent Banking.</li> <li>Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Veränderungen im Zahlungsverkehr, beispielsweise PSD3/PSR.</li> <li>Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Arbeitspaketen, Teilprojekten oder kleineren Projektteams.</li> <li>Erste praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Workflows, Generativer AI oder Automatisierung im Beratungs-, Banking- oder Payments-Umfeld.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Warum Capco</strong></p> <ul> <li>Arbeite an wirkungsvollen Projekten und Lösungen für führende Finanzinstitute.</li> <li>Erlebe eine kollaborative, offene und unternehmerisch geprägte Beratungskultur mit flachen Hierarchien.</li> <li>Nutze kontinuierliche Lern- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Trainings und Zertifizierungen für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung.</li> <li>Werde Teil eines Teams, das die Zukunft digitaler Finanzdienstleistungen aktiv mitgestaltet.</li> <li>Gestalte die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden im Finanzdienstleistungssektor mit.</li> </ul> <p>Wir bieten Dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, auf unsere Mitarbeitenden ausgerichtetes Benefits-Paket, das Dich in unterschiedlichen Bereichen Deines Berufs- und Privatlebens unterstützt.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten je nach Projekteinsatz möglich.</li> <li>Ein umfassendes Onboarding und Dein persönlicher Coach und Buddy.</li> <li>Bike-Leasing-Programme.</li> <li>Wahlweise Capco Benefits Card mit monatlicher Gutschrift i.H.v. 44 EUR. oder Wellhub</li> <li>Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks sowie Mental-Health-Kurse.</li> <li>Der PME-Familienservice bietet Unterstützung für alle Lebenslagen.</li> <li>Kontinuierliches Feedback und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, z. B. über interne Trainings und Udemy Business.</li> <li>Großartige Firmenevents und After-Work-Veranstaltungen.</li> <li>Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag.</li> <li>Autonomie, flache Hierarchien, Hands-on-Mentalität und schnelle Entscheidungswege.</li> <li>Ein dynamisches, wachstumsstarkes und internationales Umfeld mit zahlreichen Möglichkeiten, Dich und Deine Talente einzubringen.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Inklusion bei Capco</strong></p> <p>Wir setzen uns dafür ein, unseren Recruiting-Prozess für alle Menschen zugänglich und unkompliziert zu gestalten. Wenn Du in einer Phase des Bewerbungsprozesses Anpassungen oder Unterstützung benötigst, lass es uns einfach wissen – wir helfen Dir gerne weiter.</p> <p>Wir schätzen die individuellen Perspektiven und Beiträge jedes Menschen. Bei Capco sind wir überzeugt, dass Du am stärksten bist, wenn Du Du selbst sein kannst. Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität und Zusammenarbeit – eine Haltung, die unsere tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und untereinander prägt.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p data-start="4202" data-end="4736">*Wichtig ist nur, dass wir zueinander passen (m/w/d) #beyourselfatwork.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Brand Manager
description: About Flink Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics. We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it. The role You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here. This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome. What you'll do Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent. Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed. Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do. Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels. Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class. Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable. Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe. Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink. Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it. What you bring A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great. Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week Excellent written and spoken English Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count) Nice to have German (spoken or written) Photo or video shooting and editing skills Experience with website design Interior design, set design or event production experience Previous startup or tech-company experience What we offer The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world A growing, ambitious team in Zürich Competitive salary and employee stock options Budget and freedom to try new ideas Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff
description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles. Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred. At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.
