title: Account Executive - Enterprise - DACH
description: Account Executive - Enterprise - DACH Munich or Berlin Language requirement: Fluency in both German & English Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI. The Role We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive - DACH to lead complex, high-value deals across large organisations across the DACH region. You’ll be responsible for building and progressing a focused set of strategic opportunities. This means navigating multiple stakeholders, building internal champions, and creating alignment across legal, technical, and commercial teams. You’ll work closely with Legal Engineers, Product, and Leadership, but you own the deal strategy and the outcome. What you’ll do Own a portfolio of high-value, enterprise opportunities Build and execute deal strategies across complex buying groups Navigate stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, IT, and Procurement Develop strong champions and drive internal alignment within accounts Lead longer sales cycles (6–12+ months) with clear structure and momentum Partner closely with GTM Legal Engineers on solution design Maintain accurate forecasting and clear deal visibility What we’re looking for Experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals Fluent in both German and English Track record of landing and expanding high-value accounts Strong stakeholder management across multiple functions Ability to build champions and navigate internal politics Structured, strategic approach to deal management High ownership and accountability for outcomes How we work We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default. This is a high performance environment. title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem

With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure. Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity. You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners. Your day-to-day Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals. Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions. Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions. Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale. Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity. Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition. Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities. Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes. Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns. Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities. Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions. You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions. You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value. You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments. You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed. You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like. You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined. You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority. You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences. You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake. You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required: Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services. Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management. Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems. APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations. Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems. Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale. Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem. Why us? This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><p> </p> <h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p><br>At Roku, the Device Monetization and Themed Experiences (DMTE) team, a part of the Advertising organization, is where the magic behind the scenes happens. We're the engineers who build the high-performance graphics and UI foundations that power the AD Display — the core technology enabling Roku's smooth, responsive, and visually rich experiences on millions of devices worldwide. Our work lives in the middleware and UI layers, and its impact is felt every time a user navigates a menu, enjoys an animated ad, or is wowed by the bespoke experience built to market the latest TV show or Movies. We thrive on solving the toughest technical challenges — from optimizing UI rendering to fine-tuning memory usage — using BrightScript (a JavaScript-like language) to deliver rock-solid, high-performance solutions. We work in a collaborative, high-trust environment where great ideas can come from anywhere, partnering closely with firmware, UI, and product teams to ensure our platform is lightning fast, reliable, and ready for the next generation of streaming innovation. If you love building the invisible foundations that make great user experiences possible, this is the team for you.</p> <p> </p> <h3><br><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <div><br>As a Senior Agentic AI Engineer in the DMTE team, you'll be the driving force behind embedding intelligent, autonomous AI capabilities into Roku's platform — reimagining how our systems create, optimize, and deliver experiences to tens of millions of devices. Rather than building UI features directly, you'll design and deploy agentic AI systems that reason, plan, and act across our development and delivery pipelines — from automating the generation of themed experiences to enabling self-optimizing rendering workflows within the AD Display. You'll leverage your years of experience in software engineering and building world class UI to build AI agents that understand the constraints of embedded, performance-critical systems and operate effectively within them. This is a role for engineers who think in terms of autonomous systems, multi-step reasoning, and tool-use architectures — and who want to fundamentally reshape how a streaming platform is built, maintained, and evolved.</div> <div> <p> </p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. <br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p> </p> </div> <h3><br><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Apply strong software engineering principles to design, build, and ship reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>Bring rigorous software engineering practices — clean architecture, testing, code review - to building systems that are reliable and performant at scale</li> <li>Apply sound software engineering fundamentals (system design, testing, code review) to ship reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>We don't train models, we don't 'fine-tune' LLMs; We build automated agentic processes</li> <li>Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems that autonomously generate, test, and optimize BrightScript/TypeScript code and UI experiences for the FRAME engine</li> <li>Architect multi-agent workflows (planning, tool-use, retrieval, execution, validation) that accelerate development and reduce manual engineering effort across the team</li> <li>Develop AI-powered automation that understands the constraints of embedded C++ environments and produces performance-safe, memory-efficient outputs</li> <li>Build and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability, accuracy, and performance in production-critical contexts</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (firmware, UI, product) to identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation and intelligent tooling</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of agentic AI research — including LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and autonomous code generation — and bring those advances into our platform</li> <li>Mentor engineers across the team on AI-first development practices and help establish best practices for human-agent collaboration</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in the role at foundation with a track record of shipping reliable, performant systems at scale</li> <li>Deep familiarity with modern LLM orchestration tools, prompt engineering techniques, and AI/ML frameworks</li> style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. title: Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.</strong></p> <p><strong>Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region.</strong></p> <p><strong>We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.</strong></p> <hr> <p> </p></div><div> <p>Most enterprise SaaS gets sold to people in offices. You'll be selling something that lives on the factory floor, across a continent of different markets, languages, and ways of working. You'll need to be as credible with a plant manager in Southampton as with a CIO in Munich.</p> <h3><strong>Role overview</strong></h3> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll bring Poka to some of Europe's best-known manufacturers. You'll help them solve real operational problems, move their digital transformation forward, and show measurable impact across their frontline operations.</p> <p>You'll own new business from the first conversation to signature. That means finding the right accounts, running discovery that gets to the heart of how a plant actually works, and building business cases that both operations and finance believe in. It also means closing multi-site, often multi-country deals with many stakeholders. You'll work alongside Sales Development, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success and our IFS partners, and you'll have a real say in how Poka grows its European business.</p> <p>This is a high-impact role for someone who pairs sharp commercial instincts with a real understanding of manufacturing and of how European enterprises buy software.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Find and develop new business across your European territory through market research, outbound prospecting and close work with the Sales Development team</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle: discovery and needs analysis, product demos, proposals, negotiation and close</li> <li>Build tailored business cases that tie Poka's platform to each prospect's operational priorities and show clear value</li> <li>Handle cross-border deals where group-level decisions have to work for local sites, works councils and regional IT</li> <li>Partner closely with Customer Success and other teams so customers move smoothly from signature to long-term value</li> <li>Keep opportunities, forecasts and account activity accurate and up to date in Salesforce</li> <li>Put AI to work in your day-to-day, from research and account planning to conversation intelligence, drafting and CRM copilots, so you sell smarter and spend more time with customers</li> <li>Bring customer insights and market feedback to leadership to help shape go-to-market strategy and product direction</li> <li>Represent Poka at trade shows, industry events and virtual conferences across Europe</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of new business experience, in B2B sales or a similar Account Executive role</li> <li>Proven experience selling SaaS, ideally into manufacturing, industrial technology or digital transformation </li> <li>Confidence leading complex sales conversations with many stakeholders, from the plant floor to the C-suite</li> <li>Experience selling across more than one European market, and an understanding of how buying differs between them</li> <li>Strong negotiation, relationship-building and problem-solving skills</li> <li>A results-driven mindset and a track record of meeting or beating sales targets</li> <li>A hands-on, curious approach to AI and modern sales tools. You already use them to work smarter and want to keep learning</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills (another language, such as German or French, is an advantage)</li> <li>Based in the UK or Ireland and willing to travel up to 40%</li> </ul> <p>We know great sellers come from varied paths. If you don't tick every box but you've consistently landed complex new business and can quickly earn the trust of operations leaders, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h3><strong>Why Poka</strong></h3> <p>Manufacturers are under pressure on three fronts:</p> <ul> <li>capturing what a retiring workforce knows</li> <li>getting new people productive faster</li> <li>getting AI onto the floor in a way operators actually use</li> </ul> <p>Poka is one of very few platforms that does all three, and it's already trusted at 3,000+ sites. Many of the world's biggest manufacturers are headquartered in Europe, so you'll be selling close to where the big decisions get made. You'll have the reach of IFS behind you and the pace and ownership of a growth-stage company.</p> </div> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #ffffff;">#LI-TK</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p data-ghq-card-content-type="paragraph"><strong>What we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li><span data-ghq-card-content-type="paragraph">Generous vacation policy</span>, additional paid days, and charity day.</li> <li>Scale-up energy with huge backing and a global yet close-knit team.</li> <li>A truly flexible schedule and remote-friendly working - including up to 8 weeks a year working from abroad.</li> <li>Wellbeing support from day one, including free 1:1 sessions with certified coaches and therapists.</li> <li>MacBook Pro, plus home-office and monthly allowances to set you up properly.</li> <li>An annual learning and development budget to keep your career moving.</li> <li>Regular team meetups and industry events - remote never means disconnected.</li> <li>A rewarding employee referral program for successful hires.</li> </ul> <p><em>Exact benefits vary by country - we'll walk you through your full local package during the hiring process.</em></p> </div> <p><em>Want to learn more about our culture? Click <a href="https://2394300.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/2394300/HR%20files/CultureBook-En-screen.pdf" target="_blank">HERE</a>.</em></p> <p><strong>Please note: </strong>An understanding of English is essential at Poka, as it is the language used during company-wide meetings and many internal communications, ensuring effective collaboration and decision-making. In addition, as Poka operates in an international environment, English is the primary language for communicating with our clients and partners, enabling us to better serve them and represent Poka in a professional manner.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Development Senior Manager
description: <p><strong>Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.</strong></p> <p><strong>GET TO KNOW US</strong></p> <p>At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. </p> <p><strong>Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Sales Development Senior Manager</strong><strong> </strong>to join our <strong>Sales </strong>team in <strong>Berlin!</strong> </p> <p>This is a<strong> hybrid</strong> role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office.</p> <p><strong>YOUR IMPACT</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the direct leader and mentor for our front-line Business Development Representative (BDR) team, fostering a culture of growth and purpose.</li> <li>Conduct live call-shadowing and deep-dive reviews to sharpen your team's ability to communicate the transformative power of Wellhub.</li> <li>Take full accountability for a team of 5–8 BDRs, guiding their professional journey and ensuring they hit the milestones that drive our mission forward.</li> <li>Lead the interview process for new talent and execute a seamless onboarding program that gets new starters hitting "active" status within 30 days.</li> <li>Excellence in building strong partnerships with marketing and sales.</li> <li>Deeply understand the UK B2B ecosystem to teach your team how to position wellbeing as a "business-critical" priority for CHROs and CFOs.</li> <li>Pivot messaging based on market shifts to ensure Wellhub remains a vital solution for companies navigating industry headwinds.</li> <li>Manage the "speed-to-lead" for inbound inquiries, ensuring high conversion rates through rigorous qualification.</li> <li>Work with the team to build hyper-personalised outbound "clusters." You’ll move beyond generic sequences to high-intent, research-backed prospecting.</li> <li>Ensure the team is getting maximum ROI out of Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and AI-assisted prospecting tools.</li> <li>Develop the best-in-class strategies for managing the rep's book of business and running the outreach-prospecting playbook and turning curiosity into attention with intention.</li> <li>Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven Track Record: 5+ years in Sales, with at least 1-2 years of experience as a Lead BDR or Front-line Manager.</li> <li>The "Coach" DNA: A passion for seeing others succeed.</li> <li>You can look at a conversion funnel and pinpoint exactly where the "leak" is-whether it’s the initial hook, the discovery call, or the hand-off to the AE.</li> <li>Proven experience managing SDR/BDR teams for a Challenger Brand or a "non-commodity" solution.</li> <li>You must demonstrate the ability to create urgency for a product that is not yet a "household name" or is perceived as discretionary spend.</li> <li>You have moved beyond "feature-selling" and can coach reps to pivot from Product Interest to Business Impact.</li> <li>You should be able to show how you’ve successfully positioned a solution as "mission-critical" during budget-conscious cycles.</li> <li>You are familiar with the HR space and can talk the CHRO language.</li> </ul> <p>We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU </strong></p> <p>With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:</p> <p><strong>WELLHUB:</strong>  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. </p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORK:</strong> As a Flexible First company, we offer options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role is Hybrid,<strong> with a minimum of 2 days per week in-office</strong>.<strong> </strong>We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.</p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: </strong> Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.</p> <p><strong>PAID TIME OFF:</strong> We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).</p> <p><strong>PARENTAL LEAVE:</strong> Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  </p> <p><strong>CAREER GROWTH:</strong> Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. </p> <p><strong>CULTURE:</strong> You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/">Learn more about our shared culture and values here. </a></p> <p><strong>And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on </strong><a href="https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/"><strong>Instagram</strong></a><strong> @lifeatwellhub</strong> <strong>and </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/wellhub/"><strong>LinkedIn</strong></a><strong>!</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub</strong></p> <p>We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.</p> <p>Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</p> <p>Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY">Read more about it here.</a></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong> #LI-HYBRID</strong></span></p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sr.Enterprise Account Executive  - Munich
description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>About Neo4j:</strong></span></div> <div> <p>Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.</p> <p>Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.</p> </div> <div><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Our Vision: </strong></span></div> <div> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.  </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.</span></p> </div></div><p><strong><br></strong><strong>About the Role:</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong> We are seeking a driven, high-energy individual who is passionate about new business acquisition and enterprise sales. As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will be responsible for executing a strategic sales plan in your assigned territory, with a focus on revenue growth and new customer acquisition. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including solution engineering (pre-sales), marketing, and professional services, to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success.</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a territory plan based on target agencies and applicable use cases, resulting in a pipeline of opportunities in the target market, that will help you achieve quarterly and annual sales metrics.</li> <li>Develop expert knowledge of Neo4j solutions and applicability in the target market.</li> <li>Develop and present to customers a strong understanding of the benefits and advantages of graph technology versus alternative database approaches.</li> <li>Execute sales cycles that employ Strategic Selling strategies and tactics.</li> <li>Build and present proposals for Neo4j solutions that involve Neo4j products and Services.</li> <li>Work with the Solution resources to scope and deliver on well-qualified POC’s</li> <li>“Land & Expand” - Grow the business in accounts that you have landed</li> <li>Provide guidance, direction, and support to your assigned SDR in their efforts to support your pipeline development.</li> <li>Provide guidance and direction to your Field Marketing resources so they can target programs to your target accounts.</li> <li>Provide guidance and direction to the Channel Director so they can target partners and programs for your target accounts.</li> <li>Maintain Neo4j<a href="http://salesforce.com"> Salesforce.com</a> CRM system with accurate information about your pipeline, in accordance with Neo4j forecasting guidelines.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Ideally, you should have:</p> <ul> <li>Coursework in database, SQL, computer programming, Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar, is desirable.</li> <li>Experience selling information management tools to customers in the enterprise market.</li> <li> 7-10 years of consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics.</li> <li>Experience with the commercial open-source business model, selling subscriptions for on-premise deployments and/or hybrid on-prem/cloud deployments. <ul> <li>Previous experience and thrive in a smaller, high-growth software company, where you have leveraged dedicated SDR resources, Field Marketing resources, and Pre-Sales Engineering helping build the business.</li> <li>Strong conviction and approach to how and where graph solutions fit into the enterprise marketplace.</li> <li>Be a hard-working, responsible, self-starter, with the ability to work remotely in a home-office environment, as well as travel to client sites to run meetings.</li> <li>Excellent references, ideally from previous Sales managers and/or customers.</li> <li>Demonstrate attention to detail, ensuring accurate entry and management of lead data in our<a href="http://salesforce.com"> SalesForce.com</a> CRM system.</li> <li>Be proficient with standard corporate productivity tools (e.g., Google Docs, MS Office,<a href="http://salesforce.com"> Salesforce.com</a>, web conferencing).</li> <li>Be a team player with the highest level of integrity and humour.</li> </ul> <strong>Languages: Fluency in both German and English is required.</strong> <p> </p> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Why Join Neo4j?</strong></span></div> <div> <p>Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. </p> <ul> <li>Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It <a href="https://neo4j.com/press-releases/neo4j-revenue-milestone-2024/">recently surpassed $200M</a> in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR <a href="https://neo4j.com/press-releases/2021-company-momentum/">over the past three years.</a> </li> <li>Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.</li> <li>84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/boston-scientific/">Boston Scientific</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/bt/">BT Group</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/caterpillar/">Caterpillar</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/cisco/">Cisco</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/comcast/">Comcast</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/department-for-education-uk/">Department for Education UK</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/ebay/">eBay</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/nbc-news/">NBC News</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/novo-nordisk/">Novo Nordisk</a>, <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/worldline/">Worldline</a>, and <a href="https://neo4j.com/case-studies/">others</a>. </li> <li>Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.</li> <li>Countless <a href="https://neo4j.com/awards/">industry awards</a>. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.</li> <li>A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. </li> </ul> <p><a href="https://www.bizjournals.com/bizwomen/news/profiles-strategies/2022/07/getting-the-job-how-gender-equity.html?page=all">Research</a> shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. <strong>If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. </strong>At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues. </p> <p>One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.</p> </div> <div><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Neo4j Values:</strong></span></div> <div> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">(we)-[:VALUE]->(relationships)<br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">(we)-[:FOCUS_ON]->(userSuccess)<br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">(we)-[:THRIVE_IN]->(:Culture {type: [‘Open’, ‘Inclusive’]})<br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">(we)-[:ASSUME]->(:Intent {direction:’Positive’})<br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">(we)-[:WELCOME]->(:Discussions {nature: ‘IntellectuallyHonest’})<br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">(we)-[:DELIVER_ON]->(ourCommitments) </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Neo4j is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. Please read the</span><a href="https://neo4j.com/privacy-policy/recruitment-process/?ref=hr-"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">privacy notice regarding Neo4j's recruitment process</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to understand how we will handle the personal data that you provide.</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> <span style="font-weight: 400;">More information at</span><a href="http://www.neo4j.com/"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://www.neo4j.com">www.neo4j.com</a></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></div> <div> </div> <div><span style="font-weight: 400;">©2026 Neo4j, Inc., Neo Technology®, Neo4j®, Cypher®, Neo4j Bloom™, Neo4j Graph Data Science Library™, Neo4j® Aura™, and Neo4j® AuraDB™ are registered trademarks or a trademark of Neo4j, Inc. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified. What you'll do Core engine development Design and build the systems that power Hydris. Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day. Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously. Protocol and integration architecture Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris. Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden. Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems. Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained. Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris. Distributed systems Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments. Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links. Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained. Technical leadership Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product. Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion. Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs. You should apply if you Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience. Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user. Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale. Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems. Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. Working language is English. German is not required. You'd be a great fit with Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management. Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525. Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments. Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation. High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction. Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation). title: Senior Product Manager - Carpool Experience
description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. The role Carpool Experience covers everything between two members once they have found each other: agreeing on the trip, talking, meeting up, and building trust. Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye. Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other. You own six product areas, used by millions of members every month: Negotiation. Before booking, passengers can ask the driver for a detour, a lower price or another special request, and add a tip. Drivers accept, decline or make a counter-offer. It launched in France in 2025 and went worldwide in 2026. It is still a new product: what it should become, and how far it can go, is yours to figure out. Messaging. The chat between drivers and passengers. Next up: Group Chat, and catching up with market standards. GPS Tracking: both the technical capability as well as features it enables (including sharing ETA on the map, ESC bonus in Spain among others) Post-Carpool ride XP (claims, ratings etc.). How members build trust in each other. This includes AI Ratings Summary, BlaBlaCar's first consumer-facing GenAI feature. Communication Service and contact preferences. The platform that sends every push notification, email, SMS and WhatsApp message across the company, plus the settings members use to choose what they receive. Marketing tools. Braze and deeplinks, used by the CRM and marketing teams. This is a key scope, and you own its strategy. That comes with high exposure: you present to the Executive Committee every two weeks. You get a direct say in company decisions, and you are expected to bring clear thinking and solid arguments to the table. Your Responsibilities Set the direction. Build the vision and strategy for your scope, turn it into ambitious OKRs, and get leadership behind them. Own the numbers. Know your business metrics, reliability targets and costs in detail. Review them every month and act on what they tell you, without being asked. Shape the future of Negotiation. Work out where its real value is for members and for BlaBlaCar, decide how it should evolve (new use cases such as negotiation after booking, conversion, usage), and prove the impact on passengers (PAX) and GMV. Ship the next member interactions: Group Chat, live location for both drivers and passengers, and the next version of the Communication Service. Run experiments and rollouts with discipline. Run A/B tests and country-by-country launches with decision rules set in advance, together with Legal, Privacy and country leads. Hold your own with the ExCo. Every two weeks, present progress, decisions and trade-offs to the Executive Committee. Take a clear position, defend it, and change it when the evidence calls for it. Raise the bar of the product team. Share your methods, coach other PMs, and challenge how we work. Your Qualifications You take full ownership of your product's outcomes. You go to the data with a question, spot what changed before anyone flags it, and act on it. You don't wait for direction: you come with a clear proposal, build it with your team and stakeholders, and follow through. You turn many signals into one clear strategy. You combine data, user research, market moves and tech constraints into one view of where the product should go, not a list of projects. You can explain it in two minutes, it holds from one conversation to the next, and you cut complexity to get more done with less. You understand the business, not just the product. You know how BlaBlaCar makes money and where your scope fits in. You can give your key metrics, their current level and what moves them without opening a dashboard. You talk about impact on PAX, GMV and costs as naturally as about features. You have strong opinions and an open mind. You take a clear position without waiting for leadership to take theirs, back it with evidence, and change your view openly when a better argument comes along. You communicate at a leadership level. You have already owned discussions with C-level or ExCo on strategy and trade-offs, and come out with decisions. You adapt your message to each audience and resolve conflicts constructively. Baseline: You have 5+ years of product management, ideally on consumer apps, including at least one scope you owned end to end over several quarters with measurable business impact. You use AI tools in your daily work. You are fluent in English. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of our Control Discipline change agenda, building the controls product platform that powers safe growth at Monzo.</p> <p>At Monzo, we don’t treat risk and controls as a bureaucratic governance process. We treat our control framework, tools, and data pipelines as an internal <em>product</em> - designed to give engineers, product managers, and business leads the ability to ship fast - and safely.</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong><em>Senior Controls Product Manager</em></strong> to join our newly established Controls Product & Enablement team within our Controls Discipline. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering, you will act as the Product Lead for Monzo’s core risk lifecycles (Issues, RCSAs, Controls, Policy, Reg Traceability). </p> <p>You won't just write requirement docs for someone else to build - you are a builder yourself. You’ll prototype low-code tools, leverage AI models, interrogate data pipelines, and architect automated workflows to turn manual risk friction into seamless, automated self-service.</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Controls team</strong></p> <p>The role will sit within the <em>Controls Product & Enablement</em> team which is part of the wider Controls Discipline  in Monzo’s 1st line of defence  Our teams work closely with cross-functional teams across the organisation including Technology, Data, Product, Operations as well and Risk & Compliance (the 2nd line of defence).  </p> <p>As this is a newly established team (wherein you’ll have two direct reports already working in the team as data and automation specialists), this role holder needs to bring a flexible and adaptable mindset, as well as a willingness to deal with ambiguity as the team establishes its operating rhythm and embeds itself within the wider business.</p> <p><strong>🔑 What you’ll do (Your Product Ownership Scope)…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the Controls Product Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy, and backlog for Monzo’s internal risk products, replacing static, manual cycles with smart, data-driven platforms (SmartSuite, Zango, Looker, and native AI integrations).</li> <li>Hands-on Prototyping & Automation: Directly design, prototype, and build automated workflows, API integrations, and low-code/no-code solutions. You'll take an idea from a problem statement to a working MVP before partnering with core Engineering (if necessary) to scale or industrialise it.</li> <li>Pioneer AI in Risk Management: Champion AI adoption across the discipline. Experiment with LLM prompting, custom agents, and automated evidence-gathering tools to solve complex control problems and dramatically reduce manual drag for Monzo staff.</li> <li>Build for Real-Time Risk Intelligence: Drive the shift from annual "point-in-time" assessments to continuous, automated monitoring. Design data triggers (e.g., incident spikes, change flags) that alert risk owners in real time.</li> <li>Product Enablement & Adoption: Ensure high-impact adoption. Work closely with first line risk owners and Risk Partners to deliver clear "write once" guidance, intuitive UI/UX workflows, and enablement that allows teams to self-serve effortlessly.</li> <li>Drive Execution & Delivery: Maintain momentum across the team’s delivery plan (guiding 2 specialised data/automation direct reports), keeping senior stakeholders engaged and removing blockers without bureaucratic overhead.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You think like a Product Manager: You obsess over user problems, value vs. effort prioritization, user experience, and shipping MVPs quickly.</li> <li>You are a Hands-On Builder: You can get under the hood with data and automation. You're comfortable with SQL, Python (or similar), APIs, workflow tools, or low-code environments to build a working prototype yourself.</li> <li>You’re AI-Curious & Practical: You actively experiment with AI/LLMs to automate manual tasks and make workflows smarter.</li> <li>You Understand Risk & Controls: You understand fundamental risk concepts (control design, RCSAs, issue management) and see the massive opportunity to transform them through tech.</li> <li>You Thrive in Ambiguity: You enjoy starting from first principles in a fast-paced environment and turning messy operational problems into slick, scalable digital solutions.</li> <li>You have experience in leading teams through change programmes, ideally within Financial Services Controls functions.</li> <li>You are hands-on and take satisfaction in supporting colleagues, projects or tasks however big or small - and can take a range of stakeholders on the journey with you</li> <li>You’re excited by what we’re doing at Monzo</li> </ul> <h3><strong>ℹ️ This role </strong><strong><em>isn’t </em></strong><strong>for you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Your technology and data experience has primarily involved defining requirements for Data or Engineering teams to build, rather than building solutions yourself.</li> <li>You aren't comfortable getting hands-on with data, automation tooling and technical problem solving.</li> <li>You aren’t comfortable with ambiguity, or thinking from first principles</li> <li>You don’t enjoy working in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>You aren’t happy taking an MVP approach and doing what’s good enough for now with iterative changes to follow</li> <li>Equally, if your experience is primarily technical and you don't have sufficient understanding of risk and controls to translate control problems into effective solutions, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £85,000 - £115,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong><br>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short call with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>Video-call with Hiring Manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Full-Loop: 3 x video-call interviews (covering Technical, Behaviours, and Leadership)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>⏳<strong>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </strong></p> <p><strong><br></strong>#LI-REMOTE<br>#CM-1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. You will decide which blocks are represented at which level of abstraction, keep the models faithful to the schematics and measured silicon. The full-chip model will then be used to verify the ASICs that control the quantum processor from room temperature down to a few kelvin.</p> <p>You'll play an important part in shaping the design, modelling and verification methodology, standards and sign-off criteria that support our work in building the world's most advanced quantum systems.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>In this position, you will build and maintain the model of the chip that the whole team simulates against, a mixed-abstraction model combining transistor-level circuits with Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS and SystemVerilog real-number behavioural blocks. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> Oxford, England, United Kingdom<br><strong>Travel:</strong> As Needed<strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1805 </p> <p><strong>The Role: <br></strong></p> <p>We’re looking for an enthusiastic and highly technical Director, Systems Software who will thrive in our dynamic cross-disciplinary environment. You’d be working closely with our skilled software engineers and our world-leading quantum scientists to plan and manage the development of software that powers our quantum computers.</p> <p>You will initially be leading a software team of around twenty software engineers with future growth of the team expected. We develop a full stack solution ranging from the real-time control & monitoring of our systems through an IR and quantum compiler layer to application demonstration. Your role will be critical in both specifying the stack as components that can be individually developed and released, and growing the team into a world-class organisation capable of developing and supporting the stack for internal and external customers.  A critical part of this will be to establish and drive suitable development, devops, release, and 3rd line support processes.</p> <p>The quantum core of our hardware is built from trapped-ion qubits, controlled by devices designed and made by a partner tier 1 fab.  We control the ions using electrical signals and laser light, driven by real-time FPGA systems and networked equipment.  The required sequences and operations are derived both by low-level experiments that our science teams produce, and by a compilation flow from quantum algorithms.  Our software stack is a combination of Python and Rust. </p> <p>We are looking for an experienced full-stack software manager, previous exposure to quantum systems is not required.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>In this position, you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate the delivery of our software projects, contributing directly to the success of our research and development roadmap.</p> <p>A focus in this role will be leading the definition and evolution of any internal team processes and the devops processes as our stack matures. You will work collaboratively with other teams to develop stronger cross-team interfaces and processes.</p> <p>Your key responsibilities can be split into two categories:</p> <p>Product management</p> conversations and external requirements</li> <li>Understand conflicting priorities and manage the team to deliver according to company needs and timescales</li> <li>Drive detailed software solutions, working with the software team</li> <li>Provide clear updates on issues and progress to all stakeholders</li> <li>Own the software team’s backlog, working with the team members and project management group to keep it up to date</li> <li>Be the first point of call for others in the company to understand how the software fits together at a high level</li> </ul> <p>Team management</p> <ul> <li>Ensure the effectiveness and efficiency of the software team and ensuring the team maintains the right balance of delivery speed and quality</li> <li>Support members of the software team, including looking out for their wellbeing</li> <li>Conducting the performance reviews for the team and supporting their career development at IonQ</li> <li>Work with the VP of Engineering to plan future growth of the software team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>To be successful, you will need proven experience managing a software organisation containing tens of engineers and subject matter experts in their respective fields.You will have a track record in setting priorities, giving clear expectations and ensuring results are suitable for the internal and external customers, with a clear understanding of critical versus urgent items.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to delegate at the appropriate level while maintaining good quality output at the pace organisation</li> <li>Excellent technical and organisational communication skills, both across the organisation and to external stakeholders</li> </ul> <p>It would also be beneficial to have an understanding of branching and release practices and when to use them and/or how to organise internal triage and support as our external customer base grows. description: <p>Are you looking to own the customer-facing experience for JetBrains products, from how individuals and organizations buy and manage software to how licensing and entitlements work behind the scenes?</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>In this role, you’ll lead the strategy for BAD (Business Application Development) Product. You’ll tackle the complex web of purchases, subscriptions, organization administration, and usage-based services, making sure our customers have a smooth, coherent experience every step of the way.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, QA, and BAD Platform, as well as Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams. You’ll have the autonomy to drive product discovery, validate hypotheses through data and experimentation, and define the long-term vision for our licensing and administration ecosystem.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for BAD Product systems.</li> <li>Uncover user friction through customer research, support data, telemetry, and feedback from internal teams.</li> <li>Map and improve end-to-end customer journeys covering purchasing, subscriptions, licensing, and administration.</li> <li>Identify gaps, overlaps, and The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service. You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships. This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed. Responsibilities Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams. Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working. Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed. Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there. Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention. Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions. Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership. Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams. A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems. Deep experience with serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers, including designing schemas with strict backward and forward compatibility guarantees for devices you cannot force-update. Strong Python and working C literacy; real depth in a modern build system such as Bazel, including writing rules and repository-level integration, not just consuming builds. Mature CI/CD and release engineering judgment: you design validation gates and rollout mechanics that encode correctness in automation, and you know which guarantees belong in tooling versus process. Sound judgment under production pressure: you can lead a time-critical fix during a vehicle launch, and you also know when to refuse a shortcut or fence one in and drive its removal afterward. Excellent written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to non-software audiences and to write decision documents that hold up over time. The instinct to lead through leverage: you measure your impact by what the team and its users can do without you. Preferred Qualifications Automotive or embedded domain experience: UDS diagnostics, vehicle variant coding, factory provisioning, or OTA update systems. Rust experience. Experience operating in multi-company or partner-engineering environments with separate review and release processes. Experience with code generation toolchains such as protoc plugins or template-based generators. Familiarity with manifest-based multi-repository workflows. title: Senior Backend Engineer (B2B SaaS Startup)
description: Our Mission Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup! We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: customs compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time. Trusted by leading brands like Siemens Healthineers, Koro, and Jack Wolfskin , we've achieved 2 x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started. Your tasks At traide AI, we believe customs specialists deserve smarter, faster workflows and the future of global trade depends on it. As a Senior Backend Engineer , you'll play a pivotal role in builing robust, AI-powered backend services and infrastructure that drives the value creation for our customers. Your main expertise lies in backend technology but you should not be afraid to contribute to other parts of the application. You'll join a tight-knit, VC-backed B2B startup - calm but ambitious - where your ideas shape both product and culture. Product Development Own the end-to-end delivery of new features and improvements in our web application across the whole stack: shaping everything from technical design to production release Write both client-side and server-side code within our well-established codebases Analyse and communicate trade-offs in technical designs in RFC style discussions, drive decisions for your projects Be the backend expert in rotating project teams, give feedback on the contribution of other team members within your area of expertise Cross-functional collaboration Work alongside designers to shape user flows, evaluate feasibility, and improve interfaces and user experience Partner with AI engineers to bring cutting-edge research and prototypes into production-ready features Contribute your perspective to product discussions, helping set direction with both technical and user impact in mind Code quality & technical excellence Set and uphold high standards for code quality, architecture, and best practices within the team Design and maintain robust automated tests to ensure reliability and quality at scale Develop and improve instructions, guardrails and feedback mechanisms for coding agents Select and configure tooling that improves developer experience and keeps our CI/CD pipeline efficient Proactively identify and solve technical challenges before they become blockers Knowledge sharing Share your expertise through code reviews, mentoring, and documentation — helping others level up and ensuring our knowledge grows as the team grows Who we’re looking for You're an experienced engineer who cares deeply about craft, but even more about impact. You love clear thinking over hype, and you're energized by the idea of turning AI research into products people actually use every day. 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , ideally building complex products in dynamic environments Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related discipline Deep proficiency in TypeScript , including advanced type-level programming Familiarity with synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns , HTTP APIs ( REST and GraphQL ), event-driven architecture, and common design patterns. Solid database skills across both relational and non-relational databases such as Postgres and Redis or similar. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud , and the services that typically come with them. You embrace AI tools in your workflow and are driven to master emerging technologies You champion code quality and drive best practices across the team You thrive in fast-moving environments - seeking opportunities to learn, grow, and both give and receive feedback Strong English skills (C1 or better); German is a plus but not required Curiosity about adjacent fields like DevOps, Security, Frontend development, AI Engineering etc. Our Tech Stack: React & Chakra UI (Component library) GraphQL Node.js & Prisma (ORM) Python & FastAPI & SQLAlchemy Postgres for storage & Redis for caching & messages Terraform / Open Tofu orchestrating Google Cloud Platform Why us? description: We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin. Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with product requirements, user experience, and target cost in mind. You solder cables, put together wiring harnesses, build test rigs, and track down problems on the bench. Tools: You work confidently in Onshape and Autodesk Fusion, including its electronics design tools. Product lifecycle: Ideally, you've taken at least one hardware product all the way from concept to series production. How you work: You get a first prototype built quickly and improve from there.
