title: Executive Assistant / Corporate Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>Executive Assistants and Corporate Administrators</strong> to join our Corporate Operations team. We ensure that the business runs smoothly and that travel, expenses and events are efficiently and correctly managed.</p> <p>We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p>This team plays a crucial role in the overall operation of the business. They run significant business operations and processes, supporting the respective department leads but also taking central responsibility for logistics, expenses, travel and scheduling. They are the secret to our success! We look for confident and effective people who have good judgment and the self-assurance to hold firm on a point of policy regardless of the seniority of people on the other side of a discussion. If you like to take responsibility and you like to ensure that things are done properly and efficiently then you will enjoy the role tremendously.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a global operation, we have open roles in teams in all time zones.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Support operations for one or more departments in the company</li> <li>Coordinate monthly reports and schedule meetings and interviews</li> <li>Organise and run international company events including logistics</li> <li>Manage quarterly and annual executive meetings</li> <li>Collaborate across teams on activities and initiatives</li> <li>Manage suppliers and stakeholders</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>A degree in a business or technical subject</li> <li>Excellent communication skills</li> <li>Responsibility, integrity and accountability</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to four times a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to learn new technology and software quickly</li> </ul> <h3>Additional skills we value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in operations and executive support</li> <li>Project management experience</li> <li>Event related experience</li> <li>Travel industry experience</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Staff Product Engineer
description: <h2><strong>About Parloa</strong></h2> <p>Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like <a href="http://booking.com">Booking.com</a>, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h2><strong>About the role:</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Product Engineer</strong>, you will work directly inside our most strategic enterprise customers. You will build the software that makes their AI agents work in production, and be measured by the difference it makes for the customer.</p> <p>Our agents are built by business users in Parloa’s platform, AMP. AMP already comes with a broad library of tools and integrations. Your job is the part AMP does not cover yet for a given customer: the last connection into their systems, or a capability the product does not have. Our customers are large enterprises in financial services, telecom, insurance, travel and retail. For them, a working prototype is where an engagement starts, not where it ends.</p> <p>The work comes in two forms. Some engagements run for years. You stay with the account, deepen its integrations and help it grow into new use cases. Others are short experiments. You test a new idea with a real customer and decide quickly whether it is worth building. At Staff level, you take on the hardest cases of both: accounts where a pilot-grade solution would fail in production, and capabilities nobody at Parloa has built before. Staff means harder problems and more ambiguity, not less hands-on work.</p> <p>On many accounts, you work alongside a Deployment Strategist. Think of the two of you as the account’s leadership team. The Deployment Strategist acts as its CPO and defines what success looks like. You act as its CTO and own the architecture and the build. On accounts without a Deployment Strategist, you own the engineering yourself.</p> <h2><strong>Areas of ownership:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the hardest engagements.</strong> Run complex programmes with several workstreams. Make the architecture decisions that span Parloa’s platform and several parts of the customer’s organization.</li> <li><strong>Build what AMP does not cover yet.</strong> Systems of record, telephony and contact-center integrations, state management, data readiness, multi-agent orchestration and retrieval. When the answer is unclear, build a prototype quickly and decide whether it is worth pursuing before Parloa invests a full quarter in it.</li> <li><strong>Own production quality and security.</strong> Evals, production readiness, observability and incident playbooks for enterprise-scale traffic. Meet the data handling standards a regulated customer expects, including PII, access control and audit trails. Debug live issues, whether they are technical or caused by model behaviour.</li> <li><strong>Grow the account, and share what belongs in the product.</strong> Drive the second use case, the second business unit, the renewal. Set the delivery standard for other engineers on complex accounts. When something you build would help every customer, flag it. That is how Parloa decides what goes into the core product.</li> <li><strong>Mentor other Product Engineers</strong>, and take part in interviewing and hiring.</li> <li><strong>Use AI well, and set the standard for it.</strong> Decide how AI-assisted work is validated before it reaches a customer’s production traffic.</li> <li><strong>Represent Parloa with senior technical stakeholders.</strong> Work directly with the customer’s principal engineers, architects and security leaders. Be the engineer commercial teams bring in when a prospect asks how the solution would work for them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What this role is not:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Not running the Parloa platform itself.</strong> That is a separate engineering role. The platform is your foundation, and you build what a specific customer needs on top of it.</li> <li><strong>Not agent configuration.</strong> Business users design and configure agents in AMP. You build the integrations and capabilities those agents need.</li> <li><strong>Not a people-management role.</strong> You are an individual contributor and write and review code every week.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>OUR TECH STACK:</strong></h2> <p>Go, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, frontier LLMs, MCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka/NATS</p> <p>You will not use all of these, and most engagements add something new.</p> <h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of professional software development</strong>, delivering production systems end to end. Fluent in TypeScript or Python, or able to get there quickly.</li> <li><strong>5+ years leading the design and architecture of large-scale production systems</strong> in customer-facing or enterprise environments, with a focus on reliability, scale and failure modes.</li> <li><strong>Experience leading agentic, spec-driven development in production.</strong> You know when a coding agent’s output is wrong and what checks it needs before it ships.</li> <li><strong>A track record in long-term accounts or fast experiments.</strong> You have owned a strategic enterprise relationship over several years, through an expansion, a renewal or a leadership change. Or you have tested new ideas at the frontier and decided quickly whether they were worth building.</li> <li><strong>Experience as a mentor or tech lead</strong>, helping engineers become independent.</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity and with customers.</strong> You work well in complex organizations, build trust quickly with new customer teams, spot risks early and keep your judgment when the stakes are high.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to travel up to 25%</strong> to customer sites, depending on the engagement.</li> <li>Strong spoken and written communication skills in English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building or deploying an LLM-powered system used by real users in production</li> <li>Hands-on experience with eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering or multi-agent orchestration (few candidates will have all of these)</li> <li>A founder or founding-engineer background</li> <li>Forward-deployed, solutions engineering, product engineering or strategic-partner experience at an enterprise software or AI company</li> <li>Voice or conversational AI, or contact center, telephony or CCaaS integration</li> <li>Experience in regulated industries such as banking, insurance or telecom</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our engineering values:</strong></h3> <p>At Parloa, we hire, promote, and evaluate based on cultural and technical excellence. You’ll thrive here if you:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Earn Trust</strong> – act with transparency and reliability.</li> <li><strong>Obsess Over Customers</strong> – always start with the customer problem.</li> <li><strong>Think Big</strong> – set bold goals and pursue them fearlessly.</li> <li><strong>Have Integrity</strong> – do the right thing, especially when it’s hard.</li> <li><strong>Disagree & Commit</strong> – debate with candor, align fast, and deliver.</li> <li><strong>Own It</strong> – take full responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.</li> <li><strong>Dive Deep</strong> – master the details without losing sight of the big picture.</li> <li><strong>Bias for Action</strong> – move fast, decide quickly, iterate fearlessly.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Value</strong> – measure success by customer and business impact.</li> <li><strong>Insist on the Highest Standards</strong> – raise the bar continuously.</li> <li><strong>Go the Extra Mile</strong> – make the impossible possible.</li> <li><strong>Hire & Elevate the Best</strong> – raise the bar with every hire.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our recruiting process:</strong></h3> <p>Recruiter Call → Technical Peer Interview → 360° Tech Interview Loop → Bar Raiser</p> <h2><strong>Why Parloa?</strong></h2> <p>We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale—and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments—this is where you do it.</p> <p>At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.</p> <p>We’ve grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we’ve kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.</p> <p>Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we’re scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p> </p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.</p> <p>Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. <a class="c-link" href="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Please click here to learn more</a>.</p> <p><strong>

title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen. Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde. Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben. Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch. Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender. Konkret: ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt. DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden. ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie. BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer. SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann. Dein Talent SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal. AUF DEN PUNKT, OHNE KALT ZU WIRKEN: Du sagst in drei Sätzen, wofür andere zehn brauchen, und klingst dabei trotzdem wie ein Mensch. Handwerksbetriebe haben keine Zeit für Marketing-Sprache und merken sofort, wenn jemand welche spricht. ZUVERLÄSSIG, NICHT VERHANDELBAR: Zugesagter Rückruf am Donnerstag heißt Donnerstag. Das ist bei uns Grundvoraussetzung, keine Stärke. DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen. DEUTSCH AUF MUTTERSPRACHNIVEAU: Unsere Partner sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe. Das Gespräch läuft auf Deutsch, inklusive Zwischentöne und Dialekt am anderen Ende. MINDESTENS 6 MONATE ZEIT: Kürzer lohnt sich für keinen von uns beiden. Bis du richtig gut in diesen Gesprächen bist, vergehen Wochen. Unser Angebot Wachstum & Kultur Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur fachlich durchstartet, sondern aktiv eine gesunde und nachhaltige Unternehmenskultur lebt. Bei uns zählt das Miteinander genauso viel wie der Erfolg. Impact & Awareness Deine Stimme hat Gewicht, im Büro und darüber hinaus. Neben deinem regulären Urlaub bekommst du zusätzliche freie Tage für Klimaaktivismus, Demos oder Projekte, die dir am Herzen liegen. Flexibilität & Vertrauen Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinem Rhythmus. Nutze unsere Flexdays, um mobil zu arbeiten – egal ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands, immer in Absprache mit deinem Team. Extra Benefits für dich Wir machen deinen Alltag einfacher: Du bekommst einen flexiblen Bonus, den du nach Lust und Laune für Dinge einsetzen kannst, die dir Freude machen – ob Fitness, Kultur oder kleine Extras. Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden Wenn der Arbeitstag mal länger wird, sorgen wir dafür, dass niemand hungrig bleibt. Bestell dir über Wolt eine Mahlzeit direkt ins Büro – easy und lecker. Community & Spirit Wir verändern die Welt – und verlieren dabei nie den Spaß. Unsere Teams bestehen aus erfahrenen Expert:innen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit. Wir suchen einen Chief of Staff mit außergewöhnlich hohem Drive und analytischer Stärke , der direkt mit unserem CEO an den wichtigsten strategischen Themen von Zasta arbeitet. End-to-End Ownership: Von Analyse und Business Case über Partnerverhandlung und Scoping bis zu Go-live und messbarem Ergebnis. Business-relevante Projekte: Neue Geschäftsmodelle, Partnerschaften, Marketing Channels, regulatorische Themen, Markterweiterungen und andere strategische Initiativen. Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau ist aufgrund unseres regulierten Steuerumfelds zwingend erforderlich. Starkes Gehalt + VSOP , ein klarer Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta (wenn dein Weg dich stattdessen zur eigenen Gründung führt, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit einem Angel-Ticket). Du bist für relevante strategische Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Business Impact verantwortlich. Achtung: Das ist keine klassische Stabs-, PMO- oder Koordinationsrolle. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, schaffst Struktur, entwickelst Business Cases, identifizierst und verhandelst mit Partner:innen und treibst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations bis zum Go-live. Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge baut und ins Ziel bringt, anstatt nur Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erarbeiten. Deine Verantwortung Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und eng mit dem Management Team an strategisch relevanten Initiativen. Deine Themen sind keine Side Projects. Sie bewegen relevante Line-Items in unserem Business Plan. Je nach Projekt bedeutet das: neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren, auf Machbarkeit prüfen und umsetzen komplexe, unstrukturierte Probleme in klare Hypothesen, Entscheidungen und Workstreams übersetzen Business Cases und Economics entwickeln und kritisch challengen externe Partner:innen identifizieren, bewerten und kommerzielle Konditionen verhandeln gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations MVPs konzipieren und umsetzen Wir messen dich nicht daran, wie gut deine Slides sind, sondern daran, ob du reale Probleme löst und messbaren Business Impact schaffst. Zwei beispielhafte ProjekteEinen neuen Geschäftsbereich aufbauen Rund um das „Altersvorsorgedepot“ entstehen in Deutschland neue Marktchancen. Du bewertest, welche Rolle Zasta darin spielen sollte – von einer Affiliate-Partnerschaft bis zu einer tief integrierten Produktlösung. Markt & Strategie → Business Case → Partner Sourcing → Verhandlung → MVP → Tech-Integration → Go-live Du entwickelst die Economics, identifizierst geeignete Partner:innen, führst Verhandlungen, bewertest regulatorische und operative Anforderungen und bringst die gewählte Lösung gemeinsam mit Product und Tech in unser Produkt. Ein sauberes „Nein“ ist für uns genauso wertvoll wie ein Go-live – wenn die Economics oder Rahmenbedingungen nicht stimmen. Einen neuen Marketingkanal erschließen Wir wollen beispielsweise testen, ob sich Out-of-Home zu einem skalierbaren Performance-Marketing-Kanal für Zasta entwickeln kann (und ja: Wir meinen Performance, nicht nur Brand). Wenn Lukas Podolski Teil des Test-Setups sein soll, bekommen wir auch das hin. Anschließend entscheiden wir anhand klarer KPIs: Scale, iterate or stop. Weitere Projekte können neue Partnerschaften, Pricing, regulatorische Themen, operative Skalierung, M&A, neue Produkte, Vertriebskanäle, vollständig neue Geschäftsmodelle oder interne Strukturen betreffen. Du übernimmst Ownership, schaffst Klarheit und bringst die Lösung ins Ziel. Exzellentes Deutsch ist zwingend erforderlich Du sprichst Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte sprachlich präzise erfassen, formulieren und verhandeln. Das ist für uns keine formale Anforderung: Zasta bewegt sich in einem stark regulierten Umfeld rund um Steuerberatung, Finanzprozesse und Verbraucherschutz. Du musst in der Lage sein, diese selbstständig zu verstehen, kritisch zu hinterfragen und präzise mit Steuerberater:innen, Partner:innen, Anwält:innen, Behörden und internen Teams zu kommunizieren. Was wir dir bieten: starkes Gehalt + VSOP direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CEO und Management Team außergewöhnlich viel Verantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum kurze Wege von einer guten Idee zur tatsächlichen Umsetzung einen bewussten Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta Wir suchen keinen Career Chief of Staff. Wir suchen einen zukünftigen Business Owner. Im besten Fall übernimmst du nach dieser Rolle einen relevanten Teil des Unternehmens selbst – als Business Owner, VP oder in einer anderen Leadership-Funktion. Und dein Weg muss nicht bei Zasta enden: Wir würden uns freuen, wenn wir dich in einigen Jahren bei der Gründung deines eigenen Unternehmens mit einem Angel-Ticket unterstützen könnten. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights. Establish clear data contracts with Data . Technology owns production and operational data systems. You build trust with teams, customers, partners, auditors, investors and boards without acting as a rescuer or creating dependence on yourself. You are business-fluent in German and English. The opportunity to combine speed and rigor for digital clinical workflows and make a tangible difference to care. A clear Product-Technology peer model with shared decisions instead of hidden hand-offs. Remote-first within Germany with flexible working hours. title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) | München-Nord
description: Über uns Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Beratung, sondern darum, Vertrauen aufzubauen, Bedürfnisse zu erkennen und unsere Kundinnen für die passende Behandlungslösung zu begeistern. Das Beste: Du arbeitest ausschließlich mit Hot-Leads. Das bedeutet, du erhältst täglich vorqualifizierte Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. Was dich bei uns erwartet Attraktives Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provisionen Flexible Arbeitszeiten Hohe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (Coaching, Academy, interne Trainings) Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Unternehmens Mitarbeiter-Events & Teamkultur Moderne Arbeitsumgebung & gute Ausstattung Mitarbeiter-Rabatte / Vergünstigungen Flache Hierarchien & offene Kommunikation Klare Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten, zum Beispiel zur Teamleitung Wertschätzung, Teamgeist und gemeinsame Erfolgserlebnisse Gute Erreichbarkeit & Parkplätze Deine Aufgaben Du berätst warme Leads, die bereits Interesse an hairfree gezeigt haben, und baust durch eine empathische und überzeugende Kommunikation Vertrauen auf. Du erkennst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Interessent*innen und führst sie professionell bis zur verbindlichen Terminbuchung. Du fasst offene Kontakte zuverlässig nach und stellst sicher, dass kein potenzieller Kunde verloren geht. Du übernimmst die vertriebliche Verantwortung für deinen Standort und entwickelst ihn gemeinsam mit deinem Team erfolgreich weiter. Du behältst Umsatzziele, Vertriebskennzahlen und die Auslastung des Standorts jederzeit im Blick und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab. Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsalltag, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Du sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Vertriebsstandards eingehalten und Kundenanfragen schnell sowie verbindlich bearbeitet werden. Du dokumentierst Gespräche, Termine und relevante Kundeninformationen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System. Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung und den anderen Standorten zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um Prozesse, Ergebnisse und die Kundenerfahrung kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Und das Beste: Du wirst Schritt für Schritt eingearbeitet und erhältst regelmäßige Trainings, damit du sicher, professionell und erfolgreich in deine Rolle hineinwächst. Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen und kannst durch deine offene, empathische Art schnell Vertrauen aufbauen. Du bringst Interesse an Beauty, Haut, Ästhetik und dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ mit. Du arbeitest gerne vertriebsorientiert und hast Spaß daran, Kund*innen zu beraten, zu überzeugen und zum Abschluss zu begleiten. Du kommunizierst klar, professionell und wertschätzend – am Telefon, im persönlichen Gespräch und im Team. title: Junior Product Owner
description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process. Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets. Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development. Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions. Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements. Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete. Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence. We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO. You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus. You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria. You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban. You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus. You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion. You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity. You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week. You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level. What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation. Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI, Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz) €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution) In-house German classes Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications) International team, English-speaking environment Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. About the Role: As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall. By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time. This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations. Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey. This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris. Key Responsibilities: Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth. Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential. Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans. Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities. Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention. Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs. Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty. Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting. Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes. Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies. Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives. Qualifications: Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets. Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy. Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value. Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis. Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively. Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene. Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership. Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform. Why Join our Account Management Team: At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions. This is an exceptional opportunity for stellar sellers who want to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive measurable business impact — helping them realize the value of Aircall through trust, expertise, and long-term partnership. Why join us? 🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities 💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall 📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit 🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset 💶 Competitive salary package & benefits DE&I Statement: At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive. We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn. Want to know more about candidate privacy? Find our Candidate Privacy Notice here. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>Job Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Ideally in Vienna, but anywhere in Spain, Poland or Germany also works</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> English (mandatory); Swedish, Spanish, German, or French is a plus</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in similar roles</li> <li><strong>Salary:</strong> €60,000 – €70,000 gross annually</li> <li><strong>Contract:</strong> Full-time, permanent</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🚀 Join fiskaly! Help Us Simplify Tax Compliance for Millions</strong></h2> <p>Millions of people interact with fiskaly every day, even if they never notice it. We're the company behind compliance at the point of sale and e-invoicing — the invisible layer that keeps receipts tamper-proof, fights tax fraud, and helps merchants across Europe ditch paper for good.</p> <p>It's B2B, it's regulatory, and yes, it's complex. If you want to build the infrastructure that quietly powers commerce for millions — you're in the right place.</p> <h2><strong>💼 The Role</strong></h2> <p>European fiscalization and e-invoicing are fragmented, technical and deadline-driven. Every country has its own rules, its own timelines and its own competitive dynamics. Our buyers: POS manufacturers, PMS and ERP vendors, retailers, resellers  are not tax experts, and they do not want to become them. They want to know what a mandate means for them and what to do about it.</p> <p>That translation is your job. You will own positioning and messaging for our products across markets, drive go-to-market for new launches and country expansions, and turn dense regulatory requirements into value propositions that land with a technical partner in Munich and a retail chain in Madrid alike.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role with a wide surface area. You will work closely with Product, Compliance, Demand Gen, Content, Sales and our country teams.</p> <p><strong>🛠️ What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own product positioning and messaging for fiskaly's fiscalization and e-invoicing products (SIGN, RECEIPT, E-INVOICE, SAFE) across multiple European markets</li> <li>Define and continuously sharpen our ICPs and buyer personas, POS manufacturers, retailers, resellers, PMS and ERP vendors, and equip Demand Gen with the segmentation, pain points and messaging they need to convert them</li> <li>Drive go-to-market strategy for new product launches and country/regulation expansions</li> <li>Translate complex regulatory and technical requirements into clear, accurate value propositions</li> <li>Build and maintain sales enablement material, battlecards, one-pagers, demo scripts with Sales and Customer Success</li> <li>Own competitive intelligence and market research across the fragmented European compliance landscape</li> <li>Feed market and customer signal into the product roadmap in partnership with Product Management</li> <li>Keep messaging consistent across DACH, Spain, Italy and our other country teams, with an ear for local nuance</li> <li>Supply the Content team with ideas at scale and shape campaign concepts with Demand Generation</li> <li>Track regulatory calendars (KassenSichV, RKSV, Verifactu, NF525, and what comes next)  these are effectively our market events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>👀 What You Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in regulated/compliance, fintech or infrastructure software</li> <li>A proven track record positioning a technically complex or regulated product for buyers who are not experts in it</li> <li>Product launches and GTM plans you have owned end to end — not contributed to</li> <li>Strong command of positioning and messaging frameworks</li> <li>Experience managing messaging across multiple countries and languages</li> <li>Hands-on sales enablement content creation</li> <li>Familiarity with competitive intelligence tools and processes</li> <li>Excellent written English and the ability to make complexity feel simple without losing accuracy</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, shifting regulatory timelines and briefs that are not fully formed</li> <li>Cultural sensitivity across DACH, Southern Europe and the Nordics</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strong plus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in fiscalization, tax-tech, payments, or POS/retail tech</li> <li>Swedish, German, French, Spanish or Italian in addition to English</li> <li>Experience working alongside legal or compliance functions on customer-facing messaging</li> </ul> <h2><strong>✅ What We Offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A team that gives you space to grow, take ownership, and learn from trying</li> <li>25 vacation days per year if you're based in Austria</li> <li>Flexible working hours and a hybrid work setup</li> <li>Budget for personal and professional development</li> <li>Hardware of your choice (Windows, Linux, or Mac)</li> <li>A company culture that values clarity, well-being, and good work over noise</li> </ul> <h2><strong>✨ Why fiskaly?</strong></h2> <p>We work on real problems that have impact, not vanity projects. Our team is pragmatic, direct, and focused on building solid tech for an industry that needs it. We care about how things work, not how they look on paper.</p> <p>If that resonates, you’ll probably enjoy working here.</p> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes Unser Tech Stack 🚀 · Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium · RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling Your Responsibilities Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance. Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact. Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal , working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity. Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes. Own capacity planning and growth forecasting , use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security. AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation. Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling , document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team. What we offer Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.) Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Storage Engineer or Platform Engineer running production storage infrastructure, with solid experience deploying, operating and debugging Ceph in production. You know the Ceph fundamentals from real-world operations: CRUSH, pools and placement groups, replication vs. erasure coding, BlueStore, scrubbing, recovery and backfill under load . You have managed storage infrastructure end to end , from the physical layer with drives, firmware, BIOS, controllers and hardware diagnostics through rebalancing, host drains, capacity expansion and hardware generation migrations. You are comfortable using Kubernetes as a control plane , not only as a workload runtime, and understand operators/controllers, custom resources, reconciliation and GitOps. You can also move confidently around OpenStack and debug issues involving Ironic, Neutron, Nova or Glance when needed. You have dealt with situations where durability really matters – such as degraded or near-full clusters, recovery under load or split-brain conditions – and you are used to making changes in a staged, evidence-based and reversible way. You have strong Linux and bare-metal skills , understand the block layer, filesystems and I/O behaviour, and are comfortable working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps . AI-assisted engineering is already part of your day-to-day work. You have practical experience with LLMs and agentic tools and know where they can meaningfully support development, testing, reviews or operations. Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi , deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role. You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership , and are comfortable debugging problems where the actual root cause may sit somewhere between storage, networking, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You would rather verify what is happening from evidence than assume how the system should behave. We work in an international environment in English , so you should feel comfortable discussing technical topics, documenting decisions and working with the team in English. title: Maintenance Technician (m/f/d) part time | ideal alongside your studies
description: Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡ Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land. As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg , you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults. You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future . Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure. Your Benefits • Unique technology: Work with the world’s first road based power plant in active operation and contribute to a GreenTech solution that currently exists nowhere else in this form. • Real opportunity to shape processes: Develop maintenance schedules, service processes, and maintenance structures together with the team instead of simply following existing procedures. • Flexible part time schedule: Work 20 to 30 hours per week with flexible working hours that can easily be combined with university studies or other commitments. • Independent work: Take responsibility for the technical operation of the plant in Hamburg and enjoy a high degree of autonomy when it comes to maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs. • Development opportunities: Grow together with the technology and take on additional responsibility for operations and service as your experience increases. • Attractive compensation: Receive competitive compensation based on your qualifications and practical experience. title: Founding Product Manager
description: Hi, we're Dana and Erik, the founders of Circonomit. We build the decision platform industrial companies use to plan their production. Dana sees the customer side. She needs to know which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim. Erik sees the engineering side. He needs requirements that are ready to be built, complete, and clear about what we deliberately leave out. The product sits between the two, and that is this role. We sell vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt. You decide what we build next, in which order, and what we decline. How you will be measured: how much of today's project work is standard product a year from now, and how quickly a recognised customer problem becomes a usable capability. We came out of RWTH research, raised €2.8M with Vorwerk Ventures, and have customers running on our models today. Small team, Cologne office. Requirements 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. You have owned a product area end to end, not only a backlog. A technical and analytical foundation: engineering, data, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling. You recognise when a requirement creates technical debt or will not be reusable at the next customer. You will not write production code. Experience deciding under incomplete information, and explaining the trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost. You are comfortable working directly with plant managers and controllers, and understand how they decide today. German at C1 level or above, and fluent English. Customer conversations happen in German. Existing work visa for Germany. You should enjoy being in front of customers in your first week, and deciding without a research team behind you. Priorities change as we learn from customers, and we make scope and trade-offs explicit together. Benefits Ownership. The roadmap, and where the line between product and customer project sits. Shaping the role. This is the founding product role. You define how product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering. Exposure. You present your roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, and you sit in the core strategy conversations. Real-world impact. Customers plan their production on our models today. Direct collaboration. Small team, no org chart. We work directly together. Weekly feedback, both ways. Compensation. Competitive salary plus a VSOP package reflecting your contribution and development in the role. Hybrid work. Our HQ is in Cologne, and we meet there regularly. Your setup and everyday extras. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket. Process: An intro call, a second conversation with the team, a 60- to 90-minute live case on a real customer requirement, then in-person conversations with the team. You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome. This is not a coordination role. Team and Context Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter. You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. title: Associate Account Manager (Paris)
description: The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions. Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management. The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. Role overview Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business. Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact. To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées. Commercial Growth Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform. Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution. Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions. Relationship Building Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption. Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications. Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits. Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey. Collaboration - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases. Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform. This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. What we are looking for Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach Added Bonus Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role. Interview Process Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins) Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins) Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager. We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks . Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe Inclusive workforce At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable. We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you. title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
description: SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. The Role As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right. You own the code that runs in the factory. What We're Looking For 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable. B-rep and Mesh Depth . You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged. Kernel Fluency . Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes. Technical Excellence . Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. Manufacturing Instinct . Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors. End-to-End Ownership . Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service. First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption. Industrial Grit . You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point. Maniacal Urgency . Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup. On-site : Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland. What we're not looking for Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship. CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them. Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it. People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job. Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities. What we offer Mission : Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space. Total Ownership : High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute. The Environ ment : Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one. The Tea m : "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards. Compensation : Competitive salary + meaningful equity. Location : Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich. Apply Resume : Focus on geometry systems you've built and owned. GitHub/Portfolio : Show us the hard problem you solved - code, papers, or parts that came off a machine because of you. Cover letter : Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? title: Staff Windows Low Level C++ Engineer - Endpoint security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p><span data-sheets-root="1">As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.</span></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our <strong>Endpoint Protection product</strong>, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (<strong>We're currently growing multiple teams</strong> and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).</p> <p>The <strong>Platform group</strong> teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:</p> <ul> <li>Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,</li> <li>usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.</li> </ul> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the<a href="https://s1.ai/endpoint" target="_blank"> EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne</a> - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.</span></p> <h3><strong>What will you do?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.</li> <li>You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.</li> <li>Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).</li> <li>Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).</li> <li>You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.</li> <li><strong>Working setup:</strong> Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What skills & knowledge should you bring?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)</li> <li>Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools</li> <li>Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment</li> <li>Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking</li> <li>Attention to detail and high coding standards</li> <li>An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why SentinelOne?</strong></h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity & Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off & Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance & Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical and insurance benefits</li> <li>Disability insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks & Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Work-from-home allowance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles. </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
