title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description: The role Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories. You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market. Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications. This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams. Your mission Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable. You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it. The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate. What you will do Drive technical co-builds with partners Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept. Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks. Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure. Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories. Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets. Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility. Produce technical marketing content Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives. Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations. Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets. Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember. Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity. Build for the audience Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work. Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype. Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance. Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology. Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication. What we are looking for A strong engineering background The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred. Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems. Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video. A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation. Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value. Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams. The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept. Excellent written and spoken English. This role may suit you if You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing. You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value. You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market. You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems. You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message. This role is probably not for you if Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations. You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it. You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete. You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes. How the role complements Product Marketing Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity. The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content. What success looks like Within the first year, you will have: Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners. Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities. Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos. Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance. Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams. About the Role Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision. EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads. Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns. Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation. Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary. Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Candidate Requirements MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent. 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics. Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes. title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description: ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. The Opportunity As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement. The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source. This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained. Your Impact Your Impact Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers. Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists. Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure. Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed. Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs). Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements. Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements. Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance. Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure. Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers. Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions. Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations. Your Profile 5 years experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure. Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D and structured problem solving. Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements. Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met. Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required. Bonus Points Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment. Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization. Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis. What We Offer The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots. Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally. The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio. We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich. Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring. title: AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments. You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices. The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels. Design and optimize distributed inference systems using approaches such as tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU workloads. Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications. Define evaluation methodologies, document experimental results, compare performance against established benchmarks, and continuously refine optimization strategies. Monitor production performance and use empirical research to identify opportunities for further improvements in scalability, efficiency, and reliability. Requirements: Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences. Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch. Demonstrated experience with low-level kernel optimization and inference optimization on mobile or other resource-constrained devices. Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications. Deep understanding of modern model-serving architectures, inference engines, and optimization techniques for high-performance AI deployment. Strong experience writing GPU kernels for mobile devices such as smartphones. Practical experience developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from model optimization through production integration on constrained hardware. Strong ability to apply empirical research and systematic experimentation to solve latency, computational, and memory challenges. Experience designing robust evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for inference systems. Knowledge of distributed inference techniques, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU clusters. Deep understanding of the mathematical foundations and architecture of diffusion models and Vision Transformers. Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques including pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV Cache optimization, and speculative decoding such as EAGLE. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an ability to investigate complex system bottlenecks and turn research findings into practical engineering solutions. Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional technical teams. Benefits: Opportunity to work on advanced AI systems spanning model serving, inference optimization, mobile computing, edge deployment, and large-scale distributed inference. Remote-first working environment with an international team. Exposure to cutting-edge AI research and practical systems engineering challenges. Opportunity to contribute to performance-critical infrastructure where improvements can have a measurable impact on real-world AI applications. Collaborative environment combining research-driven experimentation with hands-on engineering. Opportunity to work with advanced model architectures including diffusion models, Vision Transformers, and multimodal systems. Access to challenging technical problems involving GPU kernels, inference engines, memory optimization, and distributed computing. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Internal Controls Manager to join the Finance team at Monzo Bank Europe DAC based in Dublin.</p> <p>You will help Finance build and maintain a strong risk and control environment as we develop and grow our business across European markets. You will test key Finance controls, review evidence, support regulatory reporting assurance, track remediation actions and help improve the way Finance manages risk.</p> <p>Working across Financial Control, Regulatory Reporting, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Risk & Compliance and Internal Audit, you will bring your accounting expertise, strong attention to detail and a practical approach to controls. You will be comfortable challenging processes, writing clear findings and helping teams improve.</p> <p>This is a great role for someone from audit, financial control or risk assurance who wants to help build a high-quality and robust Finance control environment in a growing digital bank.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintaining a robust and well-documented risk and control environment by improving documentation, evidence standards and control processes for the Finance team, and helping to ensure Finance-owned risks are aligned with MBEU’s risk appetite and the wider Enterprise Risk Management Framework.</li> <li>Designing, maintaining and enhancing Finance risk and control matrices for key processes.</li> <li>Performing regular control testing and review of evidence across Finance processes, including financial reporting, month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, regulatory reporting, tax, treasury and capital/liquidity-related processes.</li> <li>Testing Finance controls and assessing design and operating effectiveness. Identifying control gaps, recommending enhancements, and embedding change by tracking remediation actions and progress.</li> <li>Leading and supporting Finance risk and control self-assessments, including evidence gathering, challenge and documentation.</li> <li>Preparing concise updates for Finance leadership on control testing results, open issues, remediation progress and emerging risks. Supporting risk assurance reporting to MBEU governance forums.</li> <li>Working with second-line Risk & Compliance teams on oversight reviews, assurance planning and risk reporting.</li> <li>Supporting Internal Audit and external audit requests relating to Finance controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a recognised accounting qualification, or be close to qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA Ireland or equivalent.</li> <li>Have detailed experience in audit, financial control, risk assurance, internal controls or regulatory reporting.</li> <li>Have experience in Banking, fintech or financial services experience.</li> <li>Can demonstrate a strong understanding of accounting processes, balance sheet controls, reconciliations and financial reporting risks.</li> <li>Have experience testing or reviewing controls, including assessing design and operating effectiveness.</li> <li>Can demonstrate strong attention to detail and ability to challenge evidence, assumptions and process weaknesses.</li> <li>Have experience in documenting robust processes, risks, controls, issues and remediation plans clearly.</li> <li>Have good interpersonal and influencing skills, ability to engage across various internal functions to develop, get buy-in and deliver outcomes across teams</li> <li>Have the ability to confidently present data in a meaningful and effective way; understanding the needs of the end users and tailoring presentations to their requirements</li> <li>Have experience building strong trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity, you'll own three functions that all require hands-on technical depth, not just people management.</p> <p>Platform Staff is a small, senior, AI-native team that moves to wherever the organization needs the most leverage, from standing up early scaffolding for an initiative, to taking on a high-impact customer request that doesn't fit any existing team's charter, to stepping directly into a production crisis until it's resolved.</p> <p>This role is for a technical engineering director who has personally built distributed systems, not only managed people who did. You'll use clear metrics, strong operating rhythms, and direct technical judgment so these teams deliver predictable outcomes without relying on one-person heroics.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own outcomes for Git & Gitaly Operations, including hiring and developing the Manager, Git & Gitaly Operations, and holding the function to its reliability bar across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</li> <li>Own outcomes for Nonlinear Productivity, also known as Friction Elimination, including hiring and developing the Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, and holding the function to measurable metric movement rather than activity.</li> <li>Build and oversee Platform Staff directly as a small, senior team that uses AI-assisted tools as a standard part of its work.</li> <li>Assess, case by case, what Platform Staff picks up, such as a new team that needs bootstrapping, a customer request too specific for any existing team's charter, or a crisis that needs someone in the room immediately.</li> <li>Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable.</li> <li>Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth.</li> <li>Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.</li> <li>Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context.</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed.</li> <li>A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale.</li> <li>A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team.</li> <li>People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once.</li> <li>Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week.</li> <li>A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. Through Git & Gitaly Operations, we are responsible for the production reliability of the infrastructure layer underneath GitLab's own version control system. Through Nonlinear Productivity, we drive measurable improvements to GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows. Through Platform Staff, we provide focused senior engineering capacity for high-leverage work that needs direct ownership before it can be stabilized or handed off to a permanent team.</p> <p>Collectively, we help GitLab improve the reliability, productivity, and responsiveness of the platform that powers how our customers and GitLab team members build software.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

diversity, inclusion, and belonging, strengthen candidate and hiring team experiences, and build an effective operating model for all-remote collaboration across regions and time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading recruiting in high-growth technology companies, including enterprise-scale or similarly complex hiring environments.</li> description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As Director, Support Engineering for our Bengaluru Center of Support, you'll build and manage GitLab's India-based regional support hub as a strategic peer to our Americas and Europe, Middle East, and Africa hubs. Reporting to the Vice President of Support Engineering, you'll own the hub's organizational design, headcount growth, management infrastructure, and operating standards while building a healthy team that delivers enterprise-grade technical support across Asia-Pacific and Europe, Middle East, and Africa time zones. This remote-friendly role is based in Bengaluru, India.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design and build the Bengaluru hub's organizational structure, including specialist and management roles, customer and product segmentation, and shift coverage models.</li> <li value="2">Establish the management infrastructure, operating rhythms, escalation frameworks, and quality standards needed to support sustainable headcount growth.</li> <li value="3">Manage hiring and retention in partnership with Talent Acquisition, including role profiles, interview panels, offer selections, career paths, internal mobility, recognition, and team culture.</li> <li value="4">Develop managers and support engineers, set clear performance expectations, provide transparent feedback, and create pathways into global Support Engineering management roles.</li> <li value="5">Own performance against service-level targets, customer satisfaction, ticket quality, resolution metrics, and transparent reporting against global key performance indicators.</li> <li value="6">Implement local escalation workflows, Request for Help integration, and shift handoff protocols across the Asia-Pacific, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Americas support hubs.</li> <li value="7"><strong>Guide</strong> the hub's use of GitLab's artificial intelligence toolchain and partner with Support Operations and Strategy on tooling, analytics, and process automation.</li> <li value="8">Work with regional Support Engineering managers, Product, Engineering, and the Vice President of Support Engineering on global strategy, customer insights, operating plans, headcount models, and the Support Engineering roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience managing technical support engineering or a closely related customer-facing technical function, including through a manager-of-managers structure.</li> <li value="2">A record of building or significantly scaling a support organization, including organizational design, hiring infrastructure, onboarding, and team culture.</li> <li value="3">Experience establishing a global delivery hub or Center of Support and coordinating service delivery across regions and time zones.</li> <li value="4">Deep knowledge of supporting enterprise software as a service, including managing service-level obligations, tiered support models, escalation frameworks, and operational metrics.</li> <li value="5">Experience working in a distributed environment that combines asynchronous and synchronous collaboration, with clear written and verbal communication.</li> <li value="6">Familiarity with AI-assisted support tooling and experience introducing new tools or automation at scale.</li> <li value="7">Demonstrated ability to retain and develop technical team members in a dynamic hiring market.</li> <li value="8">Knowledge of DevSecOps platforms, continuous integration and continuous delivery tooling, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure, along with experience using support platforms such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Decagon, or equivalent tools. Experience with GitLab as a user, administrator, or customer is helpful.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The GitLab Support Engineering team is distributed across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. Support engineers and managers work on tickets and help GitLab's customers. We also examine code and logs to find root causes. We solve complex problems collectively, participate in pairing sessions and one-on-ones, and stay in communication across time zones through deliberate asynchronous work habits. the SaaS Production team.</li> <li class="li3">Contribute to improving support processes, tools, and automation within our issue tracker to make troubleshooting and case handling more efficient.</li> Rails.</li> <li class="li3">Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD in production or customer environments.</li> <li class="li3">Skill in writing clear, accurate support content and documentation based teams, and applying transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> </ul> <p class="p4"> </p> <p class="p1"><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p class="p3">We are a data stores for reporting and insights, especially ClickHouse, and the change data capture and event streaming pipelines that feed them, such as NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="5">Experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems.</li> <li value="6">Experience owning a project from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, execution, and monitoring.</li> <li value="7">Clear, concise communication about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems in English, with the ability to propose thorough, iterative solutions in a remote and largely title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
description: About us: DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale. Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives You're a great fit if you: Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team Take ownership and can work independently when needed Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have) What you can look forward to: Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site Collaborative and supportive work environment Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on. Who we're looking for Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow. Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism. Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming. What you'll do Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of: Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD. Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems. ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software. Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale. What you'll bring We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience. You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include: strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements) startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them) FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms) What we value We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building infrastructure that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable. Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

THE ROLE As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. YOUR BACKGROUND: A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth). Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors. Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior. Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions. Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries. Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests. Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills. title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. </li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Engagement Manager (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As an Engagement Manager in our Zurich or Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers, and you will be accountable for whether the design survives contact with production.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Run engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Feasibility & Economics:</strong> Own the answer to "will this work, and what will it cost". The evaluation approach, the unit economics per query or per case, and the point at which the business case stops closing.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Lead mixed teams of consultants, data scientists and engineers. You are the person who can tell whether the technical plan is realistic, and the person the client believes when you say that it is.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich and Lausanne offices by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time, and lead a team through both. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field. A strong technical foundation counts for more with us than where you studied.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Five to eight years across consulting and technology delivery, including at least one dedicated AI or data project.</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A strong dual affinity for business and technology. You have a deep working understanding of modern data and AI concepts — generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud architectures — and of their practical business applications. You are capable of scoping AI use cases and of discussing technical constraints and opportunities confidently with C-level stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have owned the technical shape of AI work, not only its business case. You think in terms of enterprise architecture — how a solution fits the existing landscape, what it needs from data and governance, and how it scales from pilot to full rollout — and can defend those choices to technical and commercial stakeholders alike. You will not be writing production code, but you should have been close enough to it to be credible with the engineers with which you will collaborate.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You can take a technical trade-off to a non-technical sponsor without flattening it, and be challenged by an engineer without retreating into abstraction. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.</p></div><p class="wnfdnte" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.</p> <p class="wnfdnte">This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.</p> <p class="wnfdnte">We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.</p> <p class="wnfdnte"> </p> <p class="wnfdnte"><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.</li> <li>Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.</li> <li>Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.</li> <li>Skilled in coverage-driven verification and confident debugging across RTL, testbench, and workload scenarios.</li> <li>Motivated by AI hardware and eager to learn verification strategies for new architectures and domains.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <ul data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="1" data-border-radius-top-cap="0" data-border-radius-bottom-cap="0"> <li>Contribute to verification of Tensix IP and subsystems from early planning through tape-out, owning coverage goals and driving them to closure.</li> <li>Build and maintain reusable verification environments, agents, scoreboards, and supporting infrastructure in SystemVerilog and Python.</li> <li>Develop constrained-random and directed tests and close functional, code, and assertion coverage using data-driven approaches.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across RTL and testbench while collaborating with design, firmware, compiler, and architecture teams.</li> <li>Help evolve DV infrastructure including regression flows, CI/CD integration, EDA compute environments, and reproducible setups.</li> <li>Nice to have: Exposure to functional safety (FuSa) verification concepts for automotive AI workloads.</li> <li>Nice to have: Familiarity with formal verification methodologies, SVA (SystemVerilog Assertions), or formal property verification for complex control logic and microarchitectural corner cases.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Will Learn</strong></p> <ul data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="1" data-border-radius-top-cap="0" data-border-radius-bottom-cap="0"> <li>How Tenstorrent verifies AI-native compute architectures including Tensix cores, RISC-V CPUs, precision formats such as BF16, FP4, and INT8 and on-chip dataflow impact verification complexity and coverage strategy.</li> <li>How to build scalable DV infrastructure across hybrid compute environments including containerized regression systems.</li> <li>How data analytics and modern AI tooling can enhance verification workflows and accelerate convergence.</li> </ul> <p class="wnfdnte"> </p> <p> </p> <div> <p><em>Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. title: Principal Data Strategist (m/f/d)
description: <p>Principal data strategists at Thoughtworks are experienced consultants who work with clients to create winning data solutions that meet business goals. They play a pivotal role in developing modern data architecture approaches that directly address our clients' key business objectives. Their responsibilities span in-depth reviews of current data and technology strategy, targeted data strategy, guiding clients to unlock the full potential of data, and providing high-level roadmaps.</p> <p>This role entails a mix of advisory responsibilities in data strategy and governance, coupled with a solid delivery-lead role and a breadth of data and AI ecosystem expertise.</p> <p>This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.</p> <p><strong>Job responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will collaborate closely with clients to understand their business ecosystem and goals, and co-create data and technology strategies aligned with their objectives.</li> <li>You will help define a clear vision for the client enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.</li> <li>You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.</li> <li>You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.</li> <li>You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.</li> <li>You will own the creation of end-to-end viable data solutions, keeping in mind long-term impacts and overseeing program inceptions for new product development.</li> <li>You will be responsible for formulating data governance strategies addressing security, privacy and compliance requirements.</li> <li>You will enable capability building in data strategy and governance, growing the next generation of data strategists.</li> <li>You will create differentiated assets in data strategy and governance to take to market.</li> <li>You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Job qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have extensive experience as a consultant, with a proven track record of creating data strategy and solutions that drive business value.</li> <li>You have solid experience with data platforms and technologies, and can provide advisory and consultative guidance for clients and cross-delivery teams.</li> <li>You have experience engaging with C-level stakeholders to influence and enable the operationalization of an enterprise-wide data strategy.</li> <li>You have demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capacity to lead technical teams and drive projects to successful completion.</li> <li>You are flexible and adaptable across a variety of projects, leveraging technical expertise and leadership to maximise impact.</li> <li>You have a track record of ensuring proper data governance policies, including data lineage, quality checks and classification.</li> <li>You have experience with AI and ML use cases and landscapes and can influence the build of the right solutions to harness insights from data.</li> <li>You have experience building high-level solution frameworks, leveraging paradigms such as data-as-a-product and federated governance where needed.</li> <li>You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Consulting and commercial track record</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have worked in a consultancy or professional-services environment within the last five years, driving data and AI engagements end to end (recent examples matter more than historical ones).</li> <li>You can point to data and AI pursuits you helped win and shape within the last three to five years, including deals from around €3M upwards, and you can speak concretely to their commercial shape, trade-offs and delivery.</li> <li>You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset, for example a reusable accelerator taken to market, combining solutioning, sales and delivery with tangible business outcomes.</li> <li>You stay conversant with the technology and hands-on enough in at least one relevant area to earn technical credibility with client and delivery teams, while leading primarily on strategy and advisory.</li> <li>You bring significant hands-on and leadership experience in data and AI (typically 10+ years) and, above all, the appetite to keep building: growing accounts, teams and capability rather than only overseeing them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Professional Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.</li> <li>You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.</li> <li>You don't shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.</li> <li>You coach, mentor and motivate others and aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.</li> <li>You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.</li> <li>Cultivating strong partnerships comes naturally to you; you understand how relationship building brings new opportunities to our business.</li> <li>You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other things to know</strong></p> <p><strong>Learning & Development</strong></p> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> <p><strong>Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</strong></p> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.</p> <p>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions.
